texts.text:
啊……终于得以从那洗手间般的牢笼中解脱了……
 Ah... At last, to be graced with the sweet release from the gaol that was the restroom...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
呼呼，你好呀～
 Fuhu, hello there~
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
*叹气*……真是可怜！诚然，无聊的疯病竟连小鸿璐也不放过，肆虐得他如今已开始跟茅厕外的世界攀谈起来……
 *sigh* ... What pity! Verily, the madness of boredom spareth not even young Hong Lu in its merciless rampage, for he hath begun to converse with the very world outside the restroom...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
吾亦曾为寻些乐子，与那位沉默的女士进行过瞪眼比赛……然而十局下来，吾竟无一局能胜……乏味实乃劲敌，竟能惑乱心智，使人将空气都视作同伴……唔唔……
 I too, in search of excitement, had attempted to engage in a contest of staring with the wordless lady... Yet of all 10 bouts, I failed to seize even a single victory... Tedium is indeed a formidable adversary, for it confuseth the mind to make fellows out of the very air... Hmm hmm...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
哎，我可不是在跟空气打招呼呀，堂吉诃德！我们这儿来了位新朋友，你看？
 Ah, I wasn't saying hello to the air, Don Quixote! We have a new friend with us, see?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
但丁，能劳烦你给我们介绍一下吗？
 Would you kindly introduce us, Dante?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
啊……原来如此。看来这位小娃娃是一路跟在我们身后的……不知是何方神圣？
 A-ah, quite true. It appeareth that the little bairn is on our heels... Whoever might they be?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
他们是我们在二楼捡到的。我们现在的目标，是把他们带去五楼。
 They are someone we picked up on the second floor. Our current objective is to bring them to the fifth floor.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你说……“捡到”了一个孩子……？
 "Picked up" a child, thou sayest...?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
那是一种无需言明的相互默许。
 There was a mutual consent of unspoken nature.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<红派拜托我们把他们送去五楼……>
 <The Rouges requested that we bring them to the fifth floor...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text: 哦，你说是一份委托？那便是契约了！幸会，吾乃堂吉诃德！成为最出色的收尾人，便是吾之梦想！不知汝又是何方神圣？！ Ooh, a request, thou sayest? This be a contract, then! Well met, I am Don Quixote! 'Tis my dream to become the best Fixer there is! And whoever might thou be?!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
啊……
 Ahh...

这……这是何人……？
 W-whomst...?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
呜……诶……
 Uuh... eeh...

唔……
 Hmm...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
啊……
 Ahh...

啊……
 Ahh...

唉，经理阁下？可否劳烦你为吾等引荐一番……？吾很想以一个名字来称呼这孩子，尽管他们或许连自己的名字都说不出来……
 Eh, Manager Esquire? Wouldst thou do the honors of introduction...? I would much like to call this child by a name, though they might not speak their own...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<诶、诶？我们还没问过他们叫什么名字……>
 <H-huh, we never asked their name...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text: 哦嚯？！汝与这孩子同行了这么久，竟从未想过要问他们的名字！？敢问，你们至今为止，究竟是怎么称呼这孩子的？！ Hoh?! Hast thou traveled so long with this child and thought not to ask their name!? Pray, just what have you been calling this child thus far?!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
这话说得有点欠考虑了，但丁。他们可是要跟我们一起踏上这段旅程的人——就算只是短短一段，我们至少也该努力记住人家的名字吧。
 That's a bit insensitive, Dante. They're someone who'll be coming along with us on this journey—the least we could do is try to learn their name, even if it's only for a short while.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<品牌主管……没告诉我们这孩子叫什么……>
 <The Brand Director... didn't tell us the kid's name...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<那、那个，我该怎么称呼这孩子呢？要不我们给他们起个名字？>
 <U-uhm, what should I call this kid? Should we name them?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
唔……不如我们直接问问他们本人？就算是还在学说话的孩子，有时候也能发出自己名字的音呢。
 Hmm... Why don't we ask them? Even children who are still learning how to speak sometimes know how to pronounce their own names.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……这个推测有道理。
 ... That is a reasonable conjecture.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
我们想请你告诉我们你的名字。
 We would like you to tell us your name.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
布……
 Buu...

布……
 Pwuh...
texts.speaker:
布……
 Pwuh...

texts.text:
布布……
 Pwie...
texts.speaker:
布……布布……
 Pwuh-Pwuhie...

texts.text:
啊哈！你的名字真可爱呀～
 Aha! What an adorable name you have~
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
我猜祂的名字是布布，但丁。
 I think their name is Pwie, Dante.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
哦，多么妙趣横生的名字啊，小布布！
 Oooh, what a whimsical name thou hast, young Pwie!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<呃……你确定那是他们的全名吗？>
 <Uhm... Are you sure that's their full name?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
如此浅薄的见识！放开你的心胸吧，经理阁下，每一个名字都是高贵的，都配得上属于它自己的一口气息！
 Such narrow-mindedness! Expand the horizons of thy mind, Manager Esquire, for all names are noble and worthy of their breaths!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<好啦，好啦……多谢你的教诲。>
 <Yeah, yeah... Thanks for the lecture.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
咳咳！吾在此张开双臂，欢迎汝加入吾等的冒险小队，小布布！
 Ahem! I welcome thee with open arms into our adventuring party, young Pwie!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
在启程之前，吾必须提醒汝：前路必将充满艰险！但汝无需担忧——无论遇上怎样的苦难，吾，堂吉——
 I must warn thee afore we are to proceed: the journey ahead shall be fraught with danger! Yet worry thee not—for no matter the hardship, I, Don Q—
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……为何汝要站得如此遥远，小布布？
 ... Wherefore is it that thou standest at such a distance, young Pwie?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<我觉得他们是害怕了……>
 <I think they're afraid...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
害怕？为何？
 Afraid? Wherefore?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<……我觉得他们只是对我们所有人都心存戒备。>
 <... I think they're just wary of us in general.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
但是……从我们从二楼到四楼这一路短短的旅程中所看到的，我觉得布布最害怕的人……是默尔索和我。
 But... from what I've been able to see from our brief journey from the second to the fourth floor, I think the people Pwie was most afraid of... are Meursault and me.

喔喔……仿佛我们穿过了一道门，走进了另一个世界。
 Ooooh... 'Tis as though we have walked through a portal into another world.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
汝可有什么想法要分享吗，小布布？来这儿，来这儿！喔喔……唔喔……！这家百货商店里，不知还藏着什么样的奇珍异宝呢？
 Hast thou any thoughts to share, young Pwie? Hie thee here, here! Ooooh... Hoooh...! What other wondrous curiosities await in this department store, I wonder?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
你再凑近一点，恐怕就要把那鞋吃下去了，堂吉诃德。
 Lean any closer, and you might end up eating the shoe, Don Quixote.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
咳咳，吾不过是在仔细端详一番罢了，仅此而已……
 Ahem, 'tis but a close inspection, nothing more...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
四脚人，你真是丢人现眼。分明只托付了你一件事——就一件——保持店内清洁。可我瞧见，你竟把这么简单的差事，办得一塌糊涂。
 What a disgrace you are, Four-legs. You were entrusted with but one duty—one—the shop's cleanliness. Yet I see that you've failed spectacularly at that simple task.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
尊敬的单脚人，我确实辜负了您。因我的愚钝与懈怠，未能完成这份简单的职责。
 I have indeed failed you, honorable One-leg. I couldn't carry out that simple duty on account of my stupidity and idleness.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
四脚人，你之所以要拖着那双难看的腿走路，是有原因的。愿你每迈出一步，都铭记这一点。
 There is a reason you are made to drag those unsightly legs with you, Four-legs. Remind yourself of that with every step you take.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
……我明白了，单脚人。万分抱歉。
 ... I understand, One-leg. My deepest apologies.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
恕我方才那副丢人的模样，尊贵的客人。鄙人虽卑微，如今便由我来为您效劳……当然，前提是您能容忍我这粗鄙之身。
 Forgive that shameful display, dear customer. Lowly though I am, I will now attend to you instead. ... Should you tolerate my vulgar presence, of course.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
都……都还好吗？那位独腿的女士，方才似乎欺凌汝甚是苛刻。
 Is... is all well? That one-legged woman seemed to be bullying thee quite harshly.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
在裁缝的技艺中，鞋子是一件为触碰大地、使躯体免受尘垢玷污而精心制成的衣物。触地的脚越少，其存在便越高贵——单只鞋履的意义，便也愈发崇高。
 In the sartorial arts, a shoe is an article of clothing wrought to meet the ground and spare the body from the impurities of dirt. The fewer the feet that touch the ground, the nobler the being—and the more exalted the purpose of the lone shoe.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
正如我们的名号所示，像鄙人这般卑微的四脚人，行走于世间时，肢体未免过多……
 As our names suggest, lowly Four-legs like myself walk the earth with too many appendages...
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
制鞋馆全体员工共同的夙愿，便是超脱升华为更高的存在——那便是“单脚人”，其存在本身，便昂然平衡于一条腿之上。
 The universal aspiration of the Footwear Hall employees is to ascend into a higher state of being—"One-leg," whose sheer existence is balanced proudly upon a single leg.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
这……这样啊……既然汝这么说……那么，要成为一位……“单脚人”，须得如何？
 W-well... If thou sayest so... Then what must one do to become a... "One-leg"?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
不知疲倦地精心制鞋。忠诚不渝地售卖它们。磨砺自身的躯体，使双脚愈发少地踏上大地。坚忍与执着，便是我们的救赎——
 Craft shoes with tireless devotion. Sell them in faithfulness. Discipline the body so that fewer and fewer feet may tread upon the ground. Perseverance and persistence shall be our salvation—
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
若你们还在问这种问题，想必是刚到这层楼不久吧。
 You must all be quite new to this floor, if you're still asking questions like that.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
是的，我们是。我们是从楼下上来的。
 Yes, we are. We came up from the floors below.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
从……你们是从楼下来的……？那么，你们会不会就是大家都在私下议论的那些顾客……那些不受楼层束缚的顾客……？
 From the— You're from downstairs...? Then might you be the customers everyone is whispering about...? The customers who are unbound to the floors...?
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
嗯。我们可以不受限制地在楼层间往来。
 Mm. We can travel between floors without restriction.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
我……明白了。传言竟是真的。这座百货商店的各楼层之间，本该只有传言才能穿行，所以我们从来都不知道那些传言究竟是真是假。
 I... see. The rumors were true. Only rumors are allowed to travel between each floor of this department store, so we never know whether they're true or false.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
那么……能否请你们替我确认另一则传言的真伪？
 Then... could you confirm the veracity of another rumor for me?
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
唔，是什么传言呢？
 Hm, what rumor would that be?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
以前，西西弗百货的顾客倒下之后，还能在楼下重新站起来。无论倒下多少次，他们都能从头再来一遍。
 It used to be that the customers of the Grand Magasin who collapsed could rise again on the lower floors. However many times they collapsed, they could begin anew from the very start.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
可是自从墙上出现裂缝那天起……我听说，倒下的顾客再也无法起身了——不只是这里，楼下也是如此。
 Yet ever since the day the cracks formed on the walls... I hear that collapsed customers no longer rise—not just here, but on the lower floors, too.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
这……有几分真实吗？
 Is there any... grain of truth to that?
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
是真的。这里已经无法复活了。
 It is true. Revival is no longer possible here.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……不是真的。
 ... Not true.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text: 可以再站起来的。没人想……最后就那样躺在冰冷的地上。 You can get up again. No one wantsta... just lie on a cold floor in the end.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
倒下之后……还能再醒过来的。
 You can wake up again... after you collapse.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
这听起来近乎一个倔强孩子的坚持，可是……
 It almost came off as a stubborn child's insistence, but...

……布布的语气中，带着一种说不清来由的笃定，仿佛祂确信这一切终将成真。
 ... there was a nameless confidence in Pwie's voice, as though they were certain that it would come true.

啊……那么……我还能像往常一样，在地下一层重新醒来吗……？
 Ah... Then... will I awaken again on B1, as we always have...?
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
我一直对单脚人们……满怀敬仰，敬仰他们仅凭一条腿的力量顶天立地的雄姿，将整个存在都凝聚于那一个点上。可无论我如何努力，那始终是我够不到的境界。
 I've always had so much admiration for the One-legs... and their magnificent stance as they pushed themselves against the earth with but the strength of a single leg, the whole of their existence concentrated upon a singular point. But it was always out of my reach, no matter how hard I labored.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
那么……我想从头再来一次。
 Then... I want to start from the beginning again.
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
你的声音听起来……可怕又诡异，跟一直对我说话的那道声音不一样。可是……你一定是个强大而尊贵的存在……
 Your voice feels... terrifying and uncanny, unlike the Voice that speaks to me. But... you must be someone strong and prestigious...
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
……那么，让我倒下吧，好吗？好让我从头开始，重新来过……
 ... So collapse me, won't you? So I can start anew, from the beginning...
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
啊……一切……都在……消散……
 Ah... It's all... fading away...
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
等我醒来……我会再次看见……那片蓝天……
 When I wake... I'll see the... blue skies... again...
texts.speaker:
四脚人
 Four-legs

texts.text:
你刚才跟他说的是真话吗？
 Were you telling him the truth?
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……不知道。可是……我希望那是真的。
 ... I dunno. But... I want it to be true.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>没想到，那个小家伙说的竟然是真话。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Surprisingly enough, that little thing is telling the truth.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>自从它诞生的那一刻起，曾从西西弗百货消失的那个宏大循环……便又回来了。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Ever since it was born, the great cycle that had once disappeared from the Grand Magasin... has returned.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>我猜地下一层又会重新住满空壳了吧。装着那些柔软娇嫩的存在的空壳。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>I suppose B1 will be filled with shells again. Shells housing soft, supple beings.</color>

喔……这是小默尔索的恋人，让娜小姐的声音？
 Ooh... this be the voice of young Meursault's lover, Lady Jeanne?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>呼呼，是我没错。准确说是前恋人。喂，小可爱……只要你哪天回心转意，我也不必永远当你的“前任”嘛。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Fuhu, that's me. Ex-lover, to clarify. Hey, ma puce... I don't always have to be your ex-something, if you ever change your mind.</color>
毕竟，我们还没真正好好做个了断呢，嗯？ After all, we haven't had real closure yet, hm?

声音……
 Voice...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>没错，我就是一道声音。完美而完整，跟你不一样。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Oh yes, I am a Voice. Perfect and complete, unlike you.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>红派好像对你寄予厚望呢，不过……我可说不准。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>The Rouges seem to have high hopes for you, but... I don't know.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>恐怕你这个小不点，撑不起这栋摇摇欲坠的百货商店。就连金枝，都快撑不住它了。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>I'm afraid you're way too tiny to hold up this crumbling department store. Even the Golden Bough's barely keeping it standing.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>好好养大它吧，小可爱。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Raise it well, ma puce.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>虽然我怀疑那个小东西能不能改变这一切的结局就是了。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Though I doubt that little thing could change how this ends.</color>

……所以，据让娜小姐所说……金枝是维系西西弗百货不散的最后一样东西。
 ... So, according to Miss Jeanne... the Golden Bough is the last thing holding the Grand Magasin together.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
那么……如果我们把它拿走，这地方会变成什么样？
 Then... what would happen to this place if we removed it?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
唔……诚然，封住裂缝的那层“树脂”便会消失……继而，这座百货商店必将随之崩塌……
 Hm... Verily, the "resin" sealing the fissures would disappear... whereupon the collapse of the department store would surely follow...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
喔……如此一来，被囚禁的N公司住民岂不是有望获得解放了？！那可真是一桩幸事！
 Hoh... Would not the liberation of incarcerated N Corp. residents be within reach, then?! 'Twould be a most fortuitous outcome!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……愚蠢又无知的死法……倒是很符合一个四脚人的做派。
 ... A foolish, ignorant death... Perfectly befitting a Four-legs.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
它从未理解主宰制鞋馆的自然法则。那循环之中，四脚人卑贱存在的唯一目的，便是将我们单脚人托举至受人敬仰的高位。
 It never understood the natural order that governs the Footwear Hall. The cycle in which the sole purpose of the Four-legs' base existence is to elevate us One-legs to be revered.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
……可是为什么？
 ... But why?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
为什么就因为你腿少，大家就得敬仰你？
 Why do they revere you just 'cuz you have fewer legs?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
因为唯有我这样的单脚人，才能达到那仅凭一条腿的力量顶天立地的雄姿。
 Because only a One-leg such as myself can achieve the magnificent stance where I push myself against the earth with but the strength of a single leg.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
布布抬起一条腿离地，盯着单脚人看。
 Pwie lifted a leg off the ground and stared at One-leg.

我有两条腿。可我现在用一条腿站着。
 I have two legs. But I'm standing on one leg.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
那……那才不叫雄姿。是残缺。
 That's... that's not magnificent. Imperfect.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
用一条腿站着……好难受。
 Standing on one leg's... uncomfy.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
她一时语塞——你八成戳中她痛处了，布布。
 She doesn't know what to say—you must've hit a nerve, Pwie.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
我们腿的数目，是制鞋馆中神圣旨意的象征，是我们自远古以来一直遵循的自然法则。
 The number of our legs is a symbol of divine providence in the Footwear Hall, and a natural law by which we have abided since time immemorial.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
你休想插手我们的传统，你这肮脏、令人作呕的红派杂种。异乡人们，你们也一样。
 Don't you dare meddle with our tradition, you foul, revolting Rouge-spawn. Same goes for you as well, strangers.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
这话说得可不太漂亮。
 That wasn't a very nice thing to say.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
你或许该跟布布道个歉。
 You might want to apologize to Pwie.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
鸿璐的嘴抿成了一条直线，那副常挂在唇边的笑容荡然无存。单脚人的这番长篇怒骂，似乎真的惹恼了他。
 Hong Lu's mouth straightened into a thin line, the cheerful smile that so often graced his lips gone without a trace. The One-leg's tirade seemed to have genuinely offended him.

我……肮脏，还令人作呕……？
 I'm... foul and... revolting...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……没错，就是你。看见你的那一刻，我差点就没忍住吐出来，你这令人厌恶的小害虫。
 ... Yes, you are. I barely stopped myself from retching the moment I saw you, you disgusting little vermin.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
不知道。
 I dunno.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
楼下那位女士，她……见到我很高兴。还夸了我。
 The lady downstairs, she... was happy to see me. Praised me.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
可你……却觉得我恶心。从我们见面那一刻起，就开始讨厌我。
 And you... think I'm disgusting. Hating me from the moment we met.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
可是……我还是我。跟在楼下时的我一样。为什么在你眼里，我就不一样了？
 But... I'm still me. Same me as I was downstairs. Why am I different to you?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text: 你还真是个招人烦的小东西，是吧？一个接一个地问些明摆着的事…… You really are an infuriating little thing, aren't you? Question after question about things that are so obvious...
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
不过也罢，我就大发慈悲告诉你真相吧。唯一会为见到你而高兴的，只有红派——那群腐朽而贪婪的家伙。
 But fine, I'll grace you with the truth. The only reason anyone would ever be glad to see you is that they're the Rouges—a rotten and avaricious sort.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
算了。我何必再跟这种无聊废话较真？我这就把那张放肆的嘴永远堵上。
 You know what? Why am I even subjecting myself to this useless drivel? I'll shut that impudent mouth for good.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
我们给过你说好话的机会，可是……看来你到这地步了也不打算接受。
 We gave you a chance to say nice things, but... I don't think you're going to take it at this point.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
小布布，虽然是我们的对手理亏在先，她朝你抛出那些恶毒又不公的怒骂……
 Young Pwie, though our foe was in the wrong, for she hath spewed such venomous and unjust tirade against thee...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
吾须提醒汝，无论汝多么好奇，也不该以问题回答问题——如此过度，恐怕会埋下祸根的种子。
 I must advise thee against answering questions with questions, no matter how curious thou mayest be—for doing so in excess may sow the seeds of trouble.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
好奇心固然是种可贵的品质，唉，可有些时候，人还是得懂得克制。
 Though curiosity is indeed a commendable quality, alas, there are times when one must exercise restraint.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
可是为什么……？
 But why...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
堂吉诃德的目光，一时间望向了远方，失了焦。
 Don Quixote briefly fell into a thousand-yard stare.

虽说吾这也不过是以己身经验之谈，可若一味追问不休，恐怕会招来小希斯克利夫的球棒挥来——唔呣呣！！
 Though I may be speaking from naught else but mine experience, to ask question after question may invite young Heathcliff's bat to smack—mmmpph!!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text: ……虽说那或许也是个理由……！ ... While that might be a reason...!
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……但通常来说，是因为有些问题，本质上就不好回答。这样的问题可能会伤到别人的感情，还……会让气氛变得有点尴尬。
 ... it's usually because some questions are, by their nature, troublesome to answer. You could hurt others' feelings by asking questions like that, and... even make things a little awkward.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……那真奇怪。
 ... That's... weird.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
“气氛”不能“尴尬”吗？
 Are "things" not allowed to be "awkward"?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
人们说气氛尴尬的时候，意思是感觉不自在。虽说我们自然都希望气氛能轻松自在，但有些人想不通过把话说开来达到那种平静。
 When people say that things are awkward, they mean that they're uncomfortable. Though we naturally want things to be relaxed and comfortable, some people want to achieve that peace without talking things through.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
那些人往往会靠制造误解，或是攻击那个令人尴尬的源头，来把它硬生生地清除掉。
 Those people tend to try to get there by forcing misunderstandings or by fighting the source of awkwardness to physically remove them.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
哦……我不喜欢那样。
 Oh... I don't like that.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
呼呼，是吧？
 Fuhu, right?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
可是……我不知道哪些问题会招人烦。而且我还是想问，因为我好奇嘛。
 But... I don't know what questions are troublesome. And I still wanna ask 'cuz I'm curious.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
那我该怎么办？
 What should I do?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
唔……问题会招人烦，通常是因为我们不想把动静闹大，所以……啊，要不你问之前先举手？
 Hmmm~ Questions usually become troublesome when we don't want to raise a fuss, so... Ah, how about you raise your hand before asking something?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……太麻烦了。
 ... Too much work.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
吾必须承认，这法子并非总能得到回应……但只要静静坚持，终会有位好心人瞧见汝那不懈举起的手！这难道不是个绝妙的法子吗？
 I must admit, 'tis not a method that is always reciprocated... But with quiet persistence, a kind soul shall eventually espy thy persevering hand! A most wonderful method, wouldst thou not say?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
布布思忖了鸿璐的提议片刻，歪了歪头……随后举起了一只手。
 Pwie considered Hong Lu's suggestion for a bit, cocking their head to the side... then raised a hand.

没过多久，他们便举起了双手……
 It wasn't long before they raised both of their hands...

……接着，脑子里又冒出第三个——说不定还有第四个、第五个——问题，便开始不耐烦地朝空中挥动起手来。
 ... and having thought of a third—and possibly, a fourth, and a fifth too—question, began impatiently flapping their hands in the air.

唔，不太顺手。可能得再多几只手才行。
 Mm, not very handy. Need more hands, maybe.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
您只需举起一只手，举一次即可。若有后续问题，可以等上一个问题得到解答后，再重新举起手臂提出。
 You only need to lift one hand, once. Any follow-up questions can be posed by subsequently raising your arm after the first query has been answered.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
啊哈……
 Aha...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
好主意。我觉得。
 Good idea. I think.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
还有一件事：如果您有问题要问我，不必举手。若您的问题恰好属于麻烦的那种，我会直接告知您。
 Another thing: If you have a question for me, it is unnecessary to raise your hand. When your question happens to be a troublesome sort, I will inform you directly.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
布布点了点头……随即，注意力又被别的新奇事物吸引，摇摇晃晃地朝堂吉诃德正端详着的那个展示柜走去。
 Pwie nodded... then, their attention arrested by yet another curiosity, tottered toward the display cabinet Don Quixote was observing.

嗯？你看到什么中意的鞋子了吗？
 Hm? Did you see any shoes that you find to your liking?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
鞋子……
 Shoe...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
喔哦……！
 Hoh...!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
呸……直到此刻吾才注意到！小布布，汝为何不曾穿鞋？！
 Fie... Only now did I notice! Young Pwie, how is it that thou wearest not a shoe?!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
赤足踏于这尘世之上，想必绝非什么惬意的经历，小布布……汝的肌肤，不觉粗糙吗……？也不觉得凉吗……？
 To walk this earth bare of feet cannot be a pleasant experience, young Pwie... Is it not rough on thy skin...? And cold...?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<要不要给他们弄一双……？>
 <Should we get them one...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
如果有喜欢的，我们可以给您买双鞋。
 We can purchase you a pair of shoes, if there is something you like.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……这些我都不喜欢。而且我饿了。
 ... I don't like any of these. And I'm hungry.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
不过……鞋子挺好的。我想要一双……
 But... Shoes are nice. I want one...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
<唔，说不定该带他们去个不是黑派开的店……>
 <Hmm, maybe we should try taking them to a non-Noir shop...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<下楼去吧。我记得红派在楼下也有一家店。>
 <Let's head down. I think the Rouges had a shop down there as well.
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
这会是什么地方呢……？
 What might this place be...?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
看起来这里在卖家具。
 Looks like they sell furniture here.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<还是这么暗……安静得有点渗人。>
 <Still so dark... and eerily quiet.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
正前往“快乐衣橱”最后已知的位置。
 Moving to the last known location of the Happy Closet.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text: ……哈——啊啊啊！汝是这座大厅的主人吗？！ ... H-AAAAARK!! Be thou the master of this hall?!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
哈……哈？
 H-hark...?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
不知道他们是不是不会说话呢？
 I wonder if they're unable to speak?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
我们走近时，那被称为“快乐衣橱”的存在，再次展开了自己的躯干。
 As we approach, the one they call "Happy Closet" unfurl their body once again.

跟之前见过的一样，里面挂着各种杂物和人体的部件。
 And just as we had seen before, there's an assortment of miscellany and parts of human anatomy dangling inside.

喔……这莫非是……汝会谈之道？啊，吾明白了！莫非汝正在向吾炫耀汝之收藏？
 Hoh... Could this be... thy manner of parley? Ah, I see! Thou'rt flaunting thy colección, perchance?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
又或者……说不定他们是在求我们带走他们。
 Or... maybe they're asking us to take them with us.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
我仔细搜寻了一遍，但他们的收藏品中似乎没有“红色心脏碎片”。
 I have conducted a thorough search, but there does not seem to be a "red heart shard" among their collection.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
鞋店那位商贩说过，他们是个乐善好施的灵魂……说不定已经送出去了？
 The shoe vendor did say that they are a giving soul... Maybe they gave it away already?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<说不定是这样，可是……>
 <Maybe so, but...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<……我觉得我们恐怕得像上次对付家具那样，把他们的心挖出来了。>
 <... I think we're going to have to tear their heart out like the Furnishings did last time.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……有不少视线正盯着我们，经理。
 ... There are many eyes on us, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
若贸然去摘“快乐衣橱”的心脏，很可能会激怒那些家具，招来它们的攻击。
 Immediately attempting to remove the Happy Closet's heart will most likely provoke the Furnishings into attacking us.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<真不想再来这么一遭，不过……我们先把“快乐衣橱”身上的东西分给那些家具吧。>
 <I really don't want to do this again, but... let's first distribute the Happy Closet's items to the Furnishings.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<这样它们应该就不会有意见了吧？家具得到了想要的东西，我们也能挖出“快乐衣橱”的心脏……大家都有份，谁也不吃亏。>
 <They shouldn't have any problem with it then, right? The Furnishings get what they want, and we get to rip out the Happy Closet's heart... it's fair game for everyone.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
就在我们商量该怎么对付那些家具时，布布扯下了几件“快乐衣橱”身上的小饰品。
 As we were discussing what to do with the Furnishings, Pwie tore off a few pieces of the Happy Closet's trinkets.

在我看来，与其说是出于贪念，倒更像是出于好奇——布布仔细盯着“快乐衣橱”，想看看它会不会有什么反应。
 It seemed to me it was more out of curiosity than covetousness—Pwie watched the Happy Closet carefully, trying to see if they reacted in any way.

要是分给别人……你就会变空了。
 If you share... you'll be empty.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
变空了……你还愿意吗……？
 Are you... okay with becoming empty...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
布布又扯下了几件挂在它身上的物件，可它依旧没有任何动静。直到我们走出老远，它才重新把自己合拢起来。
 Pwie takes a few more items from their body, but they still don't stir. Only when we've walked a fair distance away from them do they fold themselves shut.

texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
这……这究竟是盏灯，还是个人？着实是桩难题……
 Th-this be a lamp, or this be a man? Forsooth, a pickle indeed...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
唔……那还真是个难题。这不就看你怎么理解了吗？
 Hmm... that sure is a conundrum. Wouldn't that depend on how we look at it?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
您只需把这里的每一个存在，同时当成顾客、商品、商贩，以及人台就行了。
 You need only consider every entity here a customer, a product, a vendor, and a Mannequin all at once.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<好吧……那就先给这位穿件衣服吧。>
 <Alright... Let's start by giving this guy some clothes.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
唔嗬，好心的先生！
 Hark, kind Sir!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
哈。顾客啊。
 Aha. Customers.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
你们……你们是想买下我吗？
 Will you... Will you purchase me?
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
虽然我这弯曲的背脊，乍看之下会给人姿态不佳的印象，但这其实正是我的优势——高度与角度间的微妙搭配，保证能让任何前来寻求歇息的顾客，得到最恰到好处的照明。
 Though my bent back may give you an impression of bad posture at first, it is in fact my strength—the subtle combination of height and angle ensures that any customer in search of respite will be most appropriately illuminated.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
啊，这个嘛。其实，吾等所寻之物乃是——
 Ah, well. In truth, w-what we seek is—
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
我这身子偶尔会吱嘎作响——上一位检查我的顾客，出手着实粗鲁了些。不过不必担心，我的功能可是丝毫未受影响。
 I may creak a little—the last customer who inspected me was regrettably coarse with their hands. But worry you not. My functions are not one bit affected.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
来，摸摸我这柔软的躯干。要不要试着点亮我看看，小伙子们？
 Come, feel the softness of my body. Why don't you try lighting me up now, young fellows?
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
不、不必担忧。其实……吾只是恰巧第一眼便瞧见了汝——
 N-nay, worry thee not. In truth, 'tis simply that thou were the first to catch mine eye—
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
被我吸引住了吗？
 Caught your eye, did I?
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
呵呵呵……这话听着真叫人振奋啊。这只能说明，比起这里陈列的其他那些平庸货色，我的构造显然要出众得多！
 Well, well, well... Isn't that encouraging to hear? It can only mean that I am clearly different in terms of composition compared to the rest of the common rabble on display here!
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
或许……确有此事。汝所立之处，着实亮得晃眼呢。
 Perchance, that may be so. 'Tis quite blindingly bright where thou standest, indeed.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
眼光如此独到、深谙审美之道的人，想必一定愿意买下我吧？
 Someone with such a keen eye for aesthetic detail will surely be willing to purchase me, hmm?
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
只要4000只眼球，我就是你们的了。以我这无与伦比的舒适照明来说，这价钱简直低得离谱，容我自卖自夸一句。
 I am yours for a very reasonable price of 4,000 eyeballs. Outrageously underpriced for the unmatched coziness my lighting provides, if I do say so myself.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
我们并非来买你的。我们只是来把从“快乐衣橱”那里拿到的衣物，分发给家具馆的居民。
 We are not here to purchase you. We are only here to distribute the articles of clothing taken from the Happy Closet to the residents of the Furniture Hall.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
哦，你们说的是家具馆的那位主人啊。
 Ah. You speak of the master of the Furniture Hall.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
我都不知道它那儿有没有什么能配得上我风格的东西……好吧，让我瞧瞧你们带来了什么。
 I don't even know if they carry anything that would go well with my style... Well, let's see what you've brought me.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
布布把随身带着的衣物，在落地灯面前铺展开来。
 Pwie spread out the clothes they were carrying in front of the floor lamp.

呃……
 Erm...
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
看啊！这可是出自小布布这双慧眼精心挑选的行头！
 Behold! Outfits chosen by the most discerning hands of young Pwie here!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
我得说……这件跟我自身的审美，不太合拍……
 I must say... this piece is not entirely consonant with my own aesthetic sense...
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
唔嗯！
 Ack!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……不过，既然诸位都是毫无疑问的真正美学家，能在这家具馆中认出我这压倒性的华美，我相信这套服饰的选择，背后一定也藏着什么深奥的哲理。那……我就穿上吧，大概。
 ... However, as you are all doubtlessly true aesthetes who have managed to recognize my overwhelming magnificence within the Furniture Hall... I trust that there was some apocryphal philosophy behind this choice of fashion. I will... wear it, I guess...
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
你们给那盏破灯穿上衣服了？！太不公平了吧，他都过时多少年了，伙计们！也给我弄一套，也给我弄一套！给我打扮打扮！
 You gave that rusty old lamp an outfit?! No fair, he's been outta fashion since forever, dudes! Do me too, do me too! Decorate me!

给我穿上，我就便宜卖给你们！
 Dress me up, and I'll let you buy me at an affordable price!
它过得可真滋润啊。这后头几乎晒不到什么阳光……也让我们分一件什么吧…… He has it so good. Hardly any sunlight reaches us back here... Let us have something, too...

要是你们不肯，我们就……
要是你们不肯，我们就……
 If you won't, then we'll...
If you won't, then we'll...

都、都稍安勿躁！一切自会依次分发！
 Be-becalm thyselves! All shall be distributed in good time!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<我们回“快乐衣橱”那边，去……挑几件衣服吧。>
 <Let's head back to the Happy Closet, and... pick out some clothes.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
他们都……
 They're all...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……想穿点什么。为什么……？
 ... trying to wear something. Why...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
汝问为何？呵，那自然是为了披上华服，令那心跳都为之疾驰啊！
 Wherefore, thou askest? Why, 'tis to make one's heartbeat dash by donning an outfit most dashing!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
他们是希望被人看上。
 They are hoping to be pinned.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text: 穿上一身行头，既是一种一眼可辨的自我表达方式，也是一种固着方式。 Wearing an outfit is at once an immediately identifiable method of self-expression and infixation.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……唔，小默尔索，汝竟选了如此有趣的措辞，来阐述个性表达如何引出那令人心潮澎湃的兴奋……
 ... Mm, quite an interesting verbiage thou hast chosen to explain how individualistic expression leads to electrifying excitement, young Meursault...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
布布，你不想也有件他们那样的衣服吗？
 Don't you want to have clothes like they do, Pwie?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
不，我想要的……
 No, what I want...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我想要的是……
 What I want is...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
布布的话没有说完，陷入了沉思。
 Pwie trailed off, absorbed in thought.

我们走近时，那被称为“快乐衣橱”的存在，再次展开了自己的躯干。
 As we approach, the one they call "Happy Closet" unfurl their body once again.

跟之前见过的一样，里面挂着各种杂物和人体的部件。
 And just as we had seen before, there's an assortment of miscellany and parts of human anatomy dangling inside.

喔……这莫非是……汝会谈之道？啊，吾明白了！莫非汝正在向吾炫耀汝之收藏？
 Hoh... Could this be... thy manner of parley? Ah, I see! Thou'rt flaunting thy colección, perchance?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
又或者……说不定他们是在求我们带走他们。
 Or... maybe they're asking us to take them with us.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
我仔细搜寻了一遍，但他们的收藏品中似乎没有“红色心脏碎片”。
 I have conducted a thorough search, but there does not seem to be a "red heart shard" among their collection.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
鞋店那位商贩说过，他们是个乐善好施的灵魂……说不定已经送出去了？
 The shoe vendor did say that they are a giving soul... Maybe they gave it away already?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<说不定是这样，可是……>
 <Maybe so, but...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<……我觉得我们恐怕得像上次对付家具那样，把他们的心挖出来了。>
 <... I think we're going to have to tear their heart out like the Furnishings did last time.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……有不少视线正盯着我们，经理。
 ... There are many eyes on us, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
若贸然去摘“快乐衣橱”的心脏，很可能会激怒那些家具，招来它们的攻击。
 Immediately attempting to remove the Happy Closet's heart will most likely provoke the Furnishings into attacking us.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<真不想再来这么一遭，不过……我们先把“快乐衣橱”身上的东西分给那些家具吧。>
 <I really don't want to do this again, but... let's first distribute the Happy Closet's items to the Furnishings.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<这样它们应该就不会有意见了吧？家具得到了想要的东西，我们也能挖出“快乐衣橱”的心脏……大家都有份，谁也不吃亏。>
 <They shouldn't have any problem with it then, right? The Furnishings get what they want, and we get to rip out the Happy Closet's heart... it's fair game for everyone.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
就在我们商量该怎么对付那些家具时，布布扯下了几件“快乐衣橱”身上的小饰品。
 As we were discussing what to do with the Furnishings, Pwie tore off a few pieces of the Happy Closet's trinkets.

在我看来，与其说是出于贪念，倒更像是出于好奇——布布仔细盯着“快乐衣橱”，想看看它会不会有什么反应。
 It seemed to me it was more out of curiosity than covetousness—Pwie watched the Happy Closet carefully, trying to see if they reacted in any way.

要是分给别人……你就会变空了。
 If you share... you'll be empty.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
变空了……你还愿意吗……？
 Are you... okay with becoming empty...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
布布又扯下了几件挂在它身上的物件，可它依旧没有任何动静。直到我们走出老远，它才重新把自己合拢起来。
 Pwie takes a few more items from their body, but they still don't stir. Only when we've walked a fair distance away from them do they fold themselves shut.

那位被众人称作“快乐衣橱”的存在，再次向我们展开了身子。
 The Happy Closet, as the others called them, opens up to us once again.

话说……不知道其他家具都在找什么呢？
 So... I wonder what the other Furnishings are looking for?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
唔……那便由吾等自行决断吧。善良的衣橱啊，可否容吾等一次取走数件？
 Hm... It shall be of our choosing. Good Closet, wouldst thou allow us to take several at once from thee?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
“快乐衣橱”依旧没有任何动静。
 The Happy Closet still does not stir.

<……鉴于上次的情况，我不太确定继续分发衣服是不是个好主意……>
 <... I'm not entirely sure if it's a good idea to keep distributing clothes, considering what happened last time...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
如果您更倾向于采用更暴力的方式——
 If you would rather proceed using a more violent method—
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<算了。布布也在，就别惹不必要的麻烦了。>
 <Nah. Let's not get into unnecessary fights when we have Pwie with us.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
你为什么总在把东西送人……？
 Why are you always giving things away...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
你没有……想要的东西吗？
 Do you not have... wants?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
想要这个吗……？
 Wanna have this...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……合上了。你不喜欢收东西吗？
 ... Closed. You don't like receiving things?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
你为什么不说话？真烦人。
 Why won't you talk? Frustrating.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
还望三思，他们的名字可是“快乐衣橱”啊！说不定，正是那施舍之举，才是他们快乐的来源！
 Prithee, consider that their name is "Happy Closet!" Perchance acts of charity be what give them happiness!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
又或者，那份属于“快乐衣橱”的“快乐”，其实根本不属于他们自己。说不定，它属于其他家具。
 Or maybe that "happiness" of the Happy Closet isn't theirs at all. Maybe it belongs to the other Furnishings.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
毕竟，一个被赋予的名字……本就是赠名者心愿的结晶。
 A given name is, after all... a culmination of wishes from those who gave it.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
你们怎么这么慢？！我这骨头都要冻僵了，一点装饰都没有！
 What took you so long?! My bones're freezing from the lack of deco!
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
抱、抱歉了，好心的伙计。汝所需为何物？
 A-apologies, good fellow, What is it that thou needst?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
我想要一片脚趾甲！戴在帽子上的脚趾甲！戴上脚趾甲的话，我一定看起来特别有格调！
 I want a toenail! Toenail on my hat! I'll look so classy with a toenail on my hat!
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
脚趾甲……莫非汝所寻之物，便是这片？
 Toenail... This be the toenail thou seekest, perchance?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
我的天……你的眼睛是不是长到脚底板上了？！放到能看见的地方去试试！
 Heavens... Have you misplaced your eyes on the soles of your feet?! Try putting them where you can see!
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
这在你眼里像脚趾甲？这明摆着是条舌头！
 This looks like a toenail to you? It's obviously a tongue!
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
啊……！吾方才不也正与汝抱有同样的疑虑吗，经理阁下？虽然吾很不情愿这么说，但汝对时尚的审美，着实是毫无眼光可言啊！
 Ah...! Had I not shared much the same doubt with thee, Manager Esquire? Loath I be to say it, but thou truly hast no eye for the aesthetics of fashion!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
不过……这舌头倒是相当不错，这点我承认。跟我的灯配起来应该挺搭的。
 But... this is a pretty nice tongue, I'll give you that. It'll go quite well with my light.
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
哎呀，但愿我能卖个好价钱……
 Oh boy, hope I'll sell for a high price...
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text: 你……真的需要那个吗？ Do you... really need that?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
那当然。我需要这个，才能卖个高价。
 Of course I do. I need this to sell at a premium.
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
卖了高价之后……然后呢？
 After you sell at a premium... what then?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
什……卖高价这件事本身就是好事啊！大家都是这么说的！
 Wha—selling at a premium is a good thing in and of itself! That's what everyone says!
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
*哈欠*好困啊……
 *yawn* So sleepy...
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
我为什么非得醒着不可……？
 Why do I gotta stay awake...?
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
你好，你想要什么样的衣服？
 Hello, what outfit would you like?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
这不明摆着吗……？得要件漂亮点的，好让人赶紧买了我……啊，有了……我想要件毛茸茸的暖和外套，这样一被卖出去，我就能马上接着打盹了……
 I mean, it's obvious, isn't it...? Something beautiful so someone'll buy me soon... Ah, I know... I want a warm and fuzzy coat, so I can snooze right back to sleep as soon as I'm sold...
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
没问题，给你——
 Sure thing, here you go—
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……你要我拿这个干嘛？披我身上啊。
 ... What do you want me to do with this? Drape it over me.
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
你觉得我会费那劲起来穿衣服？你知道我有多困吗？
 You think I should be bothered to haul myself up to get dressed? Do you have any idea how sleepy I am?
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
<……老一套了吧？>
 <... Same old, huh?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
哦，哈哈……给你披上。这样如何？
 Oh, haha... Here you go. How's that?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
真舒服……真舒服。你可以走了。
 So nice... So nice. You can go.
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
我得花点时间习惯一下这份毛茸茸的舒适感……等我完全适应了，我会……呃……给你打个200只眼球的折扣。算是我的一点谢意。
 I'm gonna need some time to get used to this fuzzy coziness... I'll... uhm... give you a discount of 200 eyeballs when I'm fully acclimated. A token of my gratitude.
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
你最好把我买下来，知道吗？
 You better purchase me, okay?
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
你看起来好像没什么不一样……
 You don't seem any different...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
小嘴闭上，孩子。反正你也不会买我……
 Shush your little mouth, kid. It's not like you were going to purchase me, anyway...
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
我就喜欢你们这种主动把好货送上门的态度，兄弟们。
 I like that you're bringing me the good stuff willingly, my dudes.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text: 你们肯定是那种超酷~的顾客吧。 You guys must be the totally kewl~ kinda customers.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
谢谢你的好话。来——你想要哪一件？
 Thank you for your kind words. Here—which one would you like?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text: 你猜怎么着？我也是个超酷~的家具。唰！想都不用想。 Guess what? I'm a totally kewl~ Furnishing, too. Yoink! Didn't even need to think.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
<连犹豫都不带犹豫的啊……>
 <Didn't even hesitate, huh...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text: 既然都这样了，你们几位兄弟要不要也超酷~一把，把我买下来？ With that done, why don'tcha dudes be totally kewl~ too and buy me?
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text: 如果你们够酷~，我就给你们打个300只眼球的折扣，怎么样，兄弟们？ I'll give ya a discount of 300 eyeballs if you're kewl~ about it, how's that, my dudes?
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text: 那吾便以最酷~的方式问一句——打完这慷慨的折扣，汝之价格几何？ I ask thee, in a manner most kewl~—what be thy price, with that most generous discount?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
那就是相当合理的3600只眼球啦。够意思吧？哎呀，还是说我报价太低了？
 It makes me a totes reasonable 3,600 eyeballs. Far out, huh? Oops, or am I lowballing myself?
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
一片沉默笼罩了我们，大家都在努力消化这个荒唐的要价。
 Silence descended around us as we all struggled to come to terms with that ridiculous asking price.
嗐，看来也没那么酷~嘛，是吧？ Dang, not so kewl~ after all, huh?
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text: 那这买卖就算了吧，兄弟们。我可要挑个超酷~的买家才行。 That's gonna be a no-go for me, my dudes. I want my buyer to be totally kewl~.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
“酷”是什么意思……？
 What does it mean to be "kewl"...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text: 所谓酷~，便是酷~，不多不少。 To be kewl~ is to be kewl~, no more, no less.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
意思是变得更帅气。更潇洒，更让人钦佩。
 It means to become cooler. More dashing, more admirable.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text: 真的吗？那你们这些家具可一点也不酷~。 Really? Then you Furnishings aren't so kewl~.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
穿着从别人那里抢来的东西……
 Wearing something you've robbed from others...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text: 呃，你这么一说……有道理。不过我还是要酷~一点，就这么糊弄过去吧。 Y'know, when you put it like that... Point taken. But I'm gonna be kewl~ and just smoove over it.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
真的吗？衣橱里就剩这些了？
 Really? This is all that's left inside the Closet?
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
唔……有点失望啊，伙计们。
 Hmm... Kinda disappointing, guys.
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
你们怎么不先来找我，反倒先去找了别人？
 Why didn't you come to me first before anyone else?
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
如果你是这个意思，我们可没有故意避开你。只是碰巧按谁先吸引我们注意，就先去找谁而已……
 We weren't avoiding you, if that's what you're saying. We just happened to visit everyone here in the order they caught our eye...
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
*嗤*你这是在暗示我不如别人显眼吗？
 *scoff* Are you implying that I'm not as eye-catching as the others?
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
哼！我知道自己在这大厅里算是小巧了点，可也用不着这么没礼貌吧。
 Hmph! I know I'm on the somewhat petite side in this Hall, but there's no need to be so rude.
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
算了，这件我要了。
 Forget it, I'm taking this.
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text: 别指望我会跟你们道别，更别指望我会打折表示感谢！ And don't think you'll be getting a good-bye OR a thank-you discount from me!
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
那可太遗憾了。没折扣的话，我们可买不起你。
 That's too bad, then. We won't be able to afford you without a discount.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……哼。
 ...Hmph.
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
才、才不在乎呢！我敢打赌，很快就会有比你们有钱得多的人，愿意为我一掷千金！
 S-see if I care! I bet someone way, way richer than you'll splurge for me soon!
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
可你还是挺不起眼的。
 But you're still pretty unremarkable.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
你为什么不干脆把它还给原主呢？反正也不会有什么不同。
 Why don't you just give it back to the owner? Not like it'll change anything.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……才不要！送出去的东西，哪有再收回来的道理！
 ... No way! You can't just take back a gift!
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
谢谢……真是太谢谢你们了，能给我带来这么珍贵的东西。
 Thank you... Thank you ever so much for bringing me such a precious item.
texts.speaker:
皮革沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
希望这不算过分……不过，哦，你们带来的每一件衣服都实在太美了……我就选这件吧。
 I hope this isn't an imposition, but... Oh, every garment you brought me is simply beautiful... I'll go with this one.
texts.speaker:
皮革沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
嗯。
 Mm.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
还有这件……
 And this one...
texts.speaker:
皮革沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
还——有这件。
 Aaaaand this one.
texts.speaker:
皮革沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
每位顾客限领一件。
 One item per customer.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……啊，是吗？
 ... Ah, really?
texts.speaker:
皮革沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
哦……抱歉，我大概是有点得意忘形了。最近阳光实在太暖了，我感觉自己都要飘起来了。
 Oh... I'm sorry, I must've gotten ahead of myself. The sunshine's been so warm lately, I feel like I'm floating.
texts.speaker:
皮革沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text: 可你们不觉得，只丢给我一块破麻布，却指望我飘上云端，这也太狠心了点吗？ But don't you think it's rather heartless of you to throw me one miserable scrap of sacking and expect me to go over the rainbow?
texts.speaker:
皮革沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
这是我们的规定。
 It's our policy.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
啧。这规定也太他妈蠢了吧？
 Tsk. That's a stupid fucking policy, isn't it?
texts.speaker:
皮革沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
你他妈看什么看！滚一边去，蠢货！
 The fuck're you lookin' at! Get lost, fuckwit!
texts.speaker:
皮革沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
……那个沙发为什么这么生气？
 ... Why is the couch so mad?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
又不是它在帮我们忙。是我们在给它东西吧？
 It's not like it's doing us a favor. We're the ones giving, aren't we?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
因为那沙发觉得，我们的慷慨本就是它该得的。
 Because that couch thinks that they are entitled to our generosity.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
那些觉得理所应当的人……往往会忘了自己本该心怀感激才对。
 Those who feel entitled... tend to forget that they ought to be grateful instead.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
给我这个！
这个！
 Me this one!
This one!
texts.speaker:
双子灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
唔。
 Hmm.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
哇！
哇！
 Wow!
Wow!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
谢谢！
谢谢！
 Thankies!
Thankies!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
<至少这个还挺容易搞定的，值得庆幸。>
 <Glad this is still easy, at least.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
要买我吗？
买我！
 Wanna buy me?
Buy me!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
9900只眼球！白捡的便宜！
白捡的便宜！
 9,900 eyeballs! A steal!
A steal!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
汝之开价，乃吾等迄今所遇最为离谱之天价！
 Thine offer is the most exorbitant price we have heretofore encountered!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
对呀，对呀！
对呀，对呀！
 Yep, yep!
Yep, yep!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
因为我们超棒的！
我超棒的！
 Cuz I'm awesome!
I'm awesome!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
唉，吾等身上并无如此巨款——
 Alas, we have not with us such a grand sum of—
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
穷鬼！
穷鬼！
 What a bum!
What a bum!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
汝竟如此无情……！
 How cruel of thee...!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text: 别太往心里去，堂吉诃德。我们现在确实手头有点紧，眼球不太够用。 Don't take it too personally, Don Quixote. We are a bit strapped for eyeballs at the moment.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……我们是穷鬼吗？
 ... Are we bums?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
呸……遭此奚落，吾心如焚……小布布，吾在此立誓——纵使吾等囊中羞涩，汝亦断不会有个穷困潦倒的童年……！
 Fiiiieee... It burneth mine heart to be subjected to such derision... Young Pwie, I promise thee—though we may be ocularly disenfranchised, thou shan't grow up in an impoverished childhood...!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<还真是戳中泪点了啊……>
 <Really tugs at your heartstrings, huh...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……我们需要一枚心脏碎片。请把你的那枚交给我们。
 ... We need a heart shard. I request that you hand yours over to us.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
“快乐衣橱”一言不发地敞开了身子。
 The Happy Closet opens up without a word.

<倒也没指望他们会有什么不同，可就连这种请求，他们也毫不犹豫地敞开了身子……>
 <Not that I expected them to be any different, but they don't hesitate to open up, even for a request like this...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
唔……虽说出于必要，吾等已别无选择……但不得不说，此事仍在吾胸中一隅，留下了一股令人不适的腐朽之感。
 Hm... Though the necessity of it leaves us no other option... it must be said that this leaves a discomforting rot in one corner of my chest.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
失去心脏，便是失去性命……而性命，远比这样一份珍贵而有限的收藏，更为紧要……
 To lose one's heart is to lose one's life... And life is of greater import than even the preciously limited colección such as this...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
要是你处在同样的处境，你会心甘情愿放弃自己收藏的徽章，去帮助那些有需要的人吗？
 If you were in the same situation, would you willingly give up your collection of badges to help the people in need?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
唔嗯……若是为了救助危难之人，吾自当心甘情愿，舍弃吾之全部收藏——！
 Mmm... If it be in service of helping the troubled, then I shall fain part with my entire colección—!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text: ——唉唉唉唉唉唉唉，不过，兴许汝可发发慈悲，留下那枚限量版的殷红迷雾纪念徽章？就连那枚也要被夺走的话，吾恐怕只剩满心悲怆了…… —eeeeeeeehhhhhhhhh, though, mayhap thou wilt be merciful and spare the limited edition Red Mist commemorative badge? 'Twould leave me with naught but sorrow were I to be deprived of even that...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
徽章是什么？
 What's a badge?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
那是镌刻着伟大收尾人纪念徽标的信物；吾佩戴它们，好让他们能永远活在吾之心中。
 They are remembrances bearing commemorative emblems of great Fixers; I wear them so that they may forever live on in mine heart.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
收尾人……？那是你追随的“声音”吗？
 Fixers...? Is that the Voice you follow?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
唔嗯……汝倒是偏爱那些没有简单答案的问题啊。吾等此刻所“追随”之人，乃是经理阁下，然而……
 Hmm... Fond of questions with no easy answers, art thou not? The one we "follow" at present is Manager Esquire, yet...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
你们又不追随我，却还是想带我去更高的楼层。
 You don't follow me, but you still wanna bring me to higher floors.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
你们想要什么？
 What do you want?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
吾等所求，乃正义之伸张！若有落魄困苦之魂，吾等便愿施以援手，全然不问其苦难因何而起！
 We pursue the enactment of justice! If there be downtrodden and troubled souls, we seek to assist them with nary a concern for how their woes came to be!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
陌生人……你们说的东西好复杂。
 Strangers... You say a lotta complicated stuff.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
说了这么多，你们还是不追随我。
 With all that said, you still don't follow me.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
哦，别在那儿装模作样了。
 Oh, stop it with your pearl-clutching.

这、这是何意？还、还有……原来汝等打从一开始便能行动？！
 W-what is the meaning of this? A-and... ye were all mobile, all along?!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<可我们这次比上次大方多了啊……难道这样还不够？！>
 <But we were more generous about it than we were last time... Was that not enough?!>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
*哈欠*本想眯一会儿……可这阳光一直让我睡不着。
 *yawn* Tried to get some shut-eye... but the sunshine kept me up.
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
要想在阳光变得更暖之前，让人把我买走，我恐怕不止需要一件衣服。
 I'm going to need more than one article of clothing if I want someone to buy me before the sunshine grows even warmer.
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text: 我打赌那衣橱里头，肯定还藏着更酷~的好货。 Bet that closet's hiding even kewl~er goodies inside.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
我打赌里面肯定藏着什么高档货，你们这些没品位的蠢货根本认不出来。
 I bet they've got some luxury stuff hidden inside that you uncultured swines couldn't even recognize.
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
希望这不算过分，不过介不介意把你们手上所有的都给我？
 I hope this isn't an imposition, but would you mind giving me everything you have?
texts.speaker:
人皮沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
全部都要！
全部都要！
 Want all of it!
All of it!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
等、等等，这是——？！
 W-wait, what—?!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
让开，让开！我先挑！我先挑！！
 Move, move! Me first pick! Me first pick!!
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
……在我们还没缓过神来时，家具们便一拥而上把我们推到一边，像一群食腐鸟似的扑向了那动弹不得的“快乐衣橱”。
 ... As we reel from the sudden turn of events, the Furnishings shove us aside and descend upon the motionless Happy Closet like a flock of carrion birds.

即便被撞倒在地，它的身子依旧维持着敞开的姿态。
 Their body remains unfurled even as they are knocked down to the ground.

*哈欠*……真可惜，摇椅卖了2100只眼球。要不是它戴着那条新潮的围巾，那本该是我的。现在它可以永远睡下去了……那该有多好，多好啊……
 *yawn*... Shame, Rocking Chair sold for 2,100 eyeballs. Would've been me had they not been wearing that newfangled scarf. Now they'll get to sleep forever—must be so, so very nice...
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
继续做梦吧，你这贪心的家伙。你才是从“快乐衣橱”那儿拿衣服拿得最多的一个，知道吗？
 Keep dreaming, you greedy thing. You took the most clothes out of Happy Closet, you know?
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text: 但愿里头有块奶牛纹的小腿……那样就真的挺酷~的了，你懂吧？ Hope there's a cow-print shin somewhere in there... That'd be pretty kewl~ ya know?
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
你这贱货，你刚拿的那片下唇，本来跟我挑的那片人中是一套的！
 You bitch, that lower lip you just took is pretty much a set with the philtrum I chose!
texts.speaker:
人皮沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
眉毛留给我们！
眉毛留给我们！
 Leave the eyebrows!
Leave the eyebrows!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
借过一下。
 Excuse me.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
哦？你好啊，灯先生。你什么时候……？
 Oh? Hello, Mister Lamp. When did you...?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
要是你们跟衣橱没别的事了，就让让路吧。
 You can get out of my way if you have no further business with the closet.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
好一招明目张胆的搅局……想抢走我的潜在顾客，是吧？我可不会坐视不理！
 What brazen sabotage... Looking to snatch away my potential customers, eh? I won't take it sitting down!
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
<……真是一群秃鹫啊。>
 <... What a pack of vultures.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
住、住手！汝等岂非能瞧见，衣橱已一无所剩？！立刻停止这般掠夺之举！住手！
 H-halt! Canst thou not see, that the Closet has naught left to give?! Cease this robbery this instant! Cease!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
在堂吉诃德的紧急劝阻下，家具们稍稍退开了一些，
 The Furnishings backed off a little at Don Quixote's urgent intervention,

但依旧围着倒地的“快乐衣橱”打转，贪婪地盯着，等待抢走或许根本不存在的更多饰物的机会。
 but they continued to circle the fallen Happy Closet, greedily eyeing for an opportunity to snatch up more adornments that may or may not be there.

衣橱之所有物，皆已公平分予汝等。
 All of the Closet's possessions hath already been distributed fairly amongst thee.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
故此——
 Thus—
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……不公平。
 ... Not fairly.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
本来就不公平。窗帘分到的没别人多。
 Wasn't fair. Curtain didn't get as many pieces.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
小布布，究、究竟出了何等差池？
 Wh-whatever seemeth to be the problem, young Pwie?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
不、不，这孩子说得有道理。我确实没拿到跟你们其他人一样多的份。这可一点也不酷，兄弟们。大家本该分到一样多才对。
 No, no... Kid's got a point. I never got as many as the rest of you did. This isn't very far out, my dudes. Everyone's supposed to get the same amount.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
*哈欠*有人比别人拿得多，看来确实不太公平啊。
 *yawn* Guess it's not so fair when someone has more than others.
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
“快乐衣橱”，真的快乐过吗？
 Was the Happy Closet really happy?

……是它们的贪婪，招致了自己的败落。
 ... Their greed was their undoing.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
你是……故意指出那个差异，好让它们自相残杀的吗？
 Did you... point out the discrepancy to get them to fight each other?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
嗯。我想……
 Yeah. I thought...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……只要我一说出来，它们就会开始互相掐架。
 ... if I pointed it out, they'd start going at each other's throats.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我想它们会不择手段去多抢一件衣服，因为它们全都那么自私。
 Thought they'd do anything to get one more piece of the clothing 'cuz they're all so selfish.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
<拿走红色心脏……回多罗西娅那儿去吧。>
 <Let's take the red heart... and return to Dorothea.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
默尔索从它的胸口挖出心脏时，“快乐衣橱”的身子依旧维持着敞开的姿态。
 The Happy Closet remained unfurled as Meursault carved the heart out of their chest.

……它们……
 ... They've...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……真是把一切都给了出去，是也不是？
 ... truly given away everything, haven't they?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
堂吉诃德那阴郁的目光，久久停留在“快乐衣橱”留下的残骸上。她从外套里摘下一枚藏着的收尾人徽章，轻轻放在地上，就摆在衣橱残骸的旁边。
 Don Quixote's sullen gaze lingered on what was left of the Happy Closet. She unpinned a Fixer badge hidden in her jacket and placed it gently on the floor, next to the Closet's remains.

看到这一幕，布布也停下脚步，短暂地凝视了一会儿衣橱的残骸……
 Seeing that, Pwie also took a moment to briefly contemplate what remained of the Closet...

……做出决定后，他小心翼翼地把三楼那条红手帕，盖在了残骸之上。
 ... and after having come to a decision, carefully placed the red handkerchief from the third floor on top of the remains.

……我们走吧。
 ... Let's go.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……哦，你们好啊，亲爱的顾客们……
 ... Oh hello, dear customers...
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
你看起来气色不太好啊。
 You're not looking so good.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
算是……死里逃生了。
 Barely... escaped with my life.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
不过多亏了这样……它们拥有过的一切……如今都归我了。
 But thanks to that... everything they had... is now mine.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
看来你们……把心脏拿走了，那最珍贵的部分……所以你们之前……全都是在装没品位的吗……？
 I see that you've... taken the heart, the most precious part... So you were all just... pretending to be uncultured, huh...?
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text: 不过……既然你们对我也算有点帮助……我就破个例……不加价卖给你们…… Still... since you were of some help to me... I'll make an exception and.. sell them to you without the markup...
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
当然，别指望还有什么折扣……你们怎么敢，把心脏据为己有……？
 Don't expect any discounts, of course... How dare you take the heart for yourself...?
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
有意买下我吗？我这儿价格实惠得很。
 Have you mind to purchase me? I'm available for a very affordable price.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
我会在这儿等着的。
 I'll be waiting.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
你们怎么不快去找找“快乐衣橱”呢？
 Why don't you get a move on and find the Happy Closet?
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
前方的路已被完全堵死，眼下似乎无法通行。
 The way ahead is completely blocked. It does not seem possible to pass through for now.

四脚人，会以它所仰慕的那个形态重生吗？重生之后的四脚人……又是否仍会敬仰单脚人？
 Will Four-legs be reborn in the form it admired? Will Four-legs... once reborn... still revere One-leg?

无论我们去问谁，都不会有人能回答这个问题。
 No matter whom we were to ask, no one will answer this question.

两盏灯中，亮着的那盏，正低声呢喃着什么。它的灯罩像钟摆一样无声地摇晃着。
 Of the two lamps, the lit one whispers something. Its lampshade silently swings like a pendulum.

眨眼。
 Blink.

眨眼。
 Blink.

眨——眼。
 Bliiiiink.

那盏灯似乎在心怀感激地眨眼。
 The lamp seems to blink gratefully.

眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼眨眼
 BlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlinkBlink

……不是感激，懂了。
 ... Not grateful, got it.

我刚把手放上那张黑色沙发没几秒，便听到家具们特有的挪动声，开始从阴影中朝我们悄然逼近。
 Mere seconds after I laid my hands on the black couch, the distinct shuffling of Furnishings begin creeping up toward us from the shadows.

各式各样的家具，从我们四周吱嘎作响地活了过来……开始朝我们的方向悄悄爬近。
 Furnishings of all kinds creak to life from all around us... and begin to creep in our direction.

各式各样的家具，从我们四周吱嘎作响地活了过来……开始朝我们的方向悄悄爬近。
 Furnishings of all kinds creak to life from all around us... and begin to creep in our direction.

天花板上垂着十几条腿，每一条都穿着某种鞋子。一股令人发冷的诡异感，从心底涌了上来。
 There are a dozen or so legs hanging from the ceiling, all wearing footwear of sorts. A chilling, alien sensation cuts through me.

就像抬头看着一具吊死囚犯垂下的双腿。
 It's like I'm looking up at the dangling legs of a hanged prisoner.

摆着各式各样鞋子的展示柜。
 A display of various shoes.

布布似乎不太喜欢这些。
 Pwie doesn't seem to like these.

这个展示柜是空的。下面的标签写着【售罄】。
 This display is empty. The label underneath it says [SOLD OUT].

展示柜里空出来的地方，格外显眼。
 Empty spots in the display stand out to me.

带着金色点缀的黑色鞋子。
 Black shoes with golden highlights.

摆着各式各样、色彩缤纷的鞋子的展示柜。
 A display of various, colorful shoes.

鞋子从天花板上垂了下来。
 Shoes hang from the ceiling.

就像从地板抬头望向天花板一样。
 It's like looking up at the ceiling from the floor.

做工精致的鞋子。
 Elaborate shoes.

这双鞋里是否藏着黄金皮革，并不明显。价格倒是偏低。
 If this pair of shoes contains the Golden Hide, it's not obvious. The price is on the lower side.

嘿，伙计。那件外套看起来挺重的。要不挂到我身上来？
 Hey, man. That coat looks pretty heavy. Why don't you try hanging it from me?
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
（没有反应。看起来懒得理你。）
 (No response. Couldn't be bothered, it seems.)
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
介不介意呀，兄弟们？总算轮到我晒太阳了，你们挡着光呢。
 Do ya mind, my dudes? It's finally my turn to sunbathe, and you're blocking the light.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
喜欢我这块亮红色的坐垫吗？把我放进任何房间，我都能为它注入一份体面居家所需的恰到好处的活力！
 How do you like this bright red cushion I've got? Put me in any room, and I'll fill it with just the appropriate kind of vitality any classy home needs!
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
我这身子相当松软。走之前不妨坐一坐。唔……你现在肯定特别想坐到我身上来吧。
 My body is quite cushy. Feel free to take a seat before you go. Hmm... You must be quite tempted to sit on me right about now.
texts.speaker:
人皮沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text: 你懂不懂虚空这个词是什么意思？走开，没文化的家伙没资格买我。 Do you even know what the word Vanitas means? Go away, uneducated fools have no business purchasing me.
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
（没有反应。看起来懒得理你。）
 (No response. Couldn't be bothered, it seems.)
总有一天，会有个超酷~的顾客，愿意接受我超酷~的交易。 One day I'll get a kewl~ customer who's down for a kewl~ deal.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text: 现在的我至少值5000只眼球！不过对你嘛，我可以给个……9000只眼球的特惠价。哼！ I'll be worth at least 5,000 Eyeballs now! But for you, I'm available for... an exclusive price of 9,000 Eyeballs. Hmph!
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
哦，不好意思……
 Oh, excuse me...
texts.speaker:
人皮沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
“滚一边去，蠢货”这句话，你真的听不懂吗？
 Are you really having trouble understanding what "Get lost, fuckwit" means?
texts.speaker:
人皮沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
<有些看起来不太想跟我们说话……如果它们真的会说话的话。>
 <Some of them don't seem to want to talk to us... if they're even capable of speech.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我倒是挺想把衣服给它们的，可要是我们一开口，它们的第一反应就是攻击我们，那也没什么办法……不知道我们还有别的什么选择？
 As much as I'd like to give them the clothes, there isn't much we can do if their first reaction when we try to talk to them is to attack us... I wonder what other options we have?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
唔嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……着实是个难题……啊哈！莫非，吾等只需不断主动与之攀谈，直至它们愿意回礼便可？！
 Hmmmmmmmmm... Quite the pickle indeed... Aha! Perchance, we need only initiate conversation with them as many times as it takes for them to return the favor?!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<可每次我们找错家具搭话，默尔索都得经历一场惨烈的死法……>
 <But Meursault's going to have to go through a gruesome death every time we talk to the wrong Furnishing...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
此言不虚……
 I'faith...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
唔……啊，对了。我记得那些待在大厅明亮处的家具，就算语气冷淡了点，好像也更愿意听我们说话。
 Hmm... Ah, right. I think Furnishings in the brighter parts of the hall were more willing to lend us their ear, even if they were a little curt.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
不知道是不是光线让它们心情好了一点～？
 I wonder if the light put them in a good mood~?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<明亮处？>
 <The brighter parts?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
啊哈！确实，吾走在阳光之下时，也曾听得阵阵细微的话音，而身处阴影之中时，却是全然阒寂无声……
 Aha! Indeed, I too heard the quibble of voices when walking under the sunshine, which were entirely absent while we were in shadows...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
每一件能与之交流的家具，都暴露在光线之下。
 Every Furnishing with which communication was possible was exposed to light.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<没错……那光线肯定对家具们有什么影响。我们下去家具馆再试一次吧。>
 <Right... Then the light must be affecting the Furnishings somehow. Let's head down to the Furniture Hall and try again.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……堂吉诃德穿不了这双鞋，但拿来当礼物送给她倒是挺不错的。
 ... Don Quixote won't be able to wear these shoes, but it'd make for a nice gift for her.

在这个连用两条腿都难以站稳的世界里，要单腿挺立，无论出身多么高贵，都绝非易事。
 In a world where it is so hard to stand on even with two legs, to stand up straight on one leg is a difficult task, regardless of one's nobility.

哇啊啊啊……你们几位……
 Whoaaaaa... You guys...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
你们身边跟着一位好特别、好特别的人呢。
 You have someone so, so... special with you.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
我真是太幸运、太感激了……能有机会遇见这样一位……
 I'm so lucky and grateful... to have a chance to meet someone like that...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
布布躲到了我们身后，看起来因为这份过分甜腻的欢迎，而感到有点不安。
 Pwie hid behind us, evidently feeling a bit anxious from the overly saccharine reception.

布布，此乃其名，好心的商贩！悲喜交加之命运，将祂眼下托付于吾等照看之中……着实是个怕生的孩子啊。
 Pwie be their name, kind vendor! Fortunes both ill and good have brought them presently under our care... A bashful young child, I say.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
啊，好的。请一定好好照顾他。哦对了，要是你们想看看店里的鞋子……最好动作快点。
 Ah, yes. Please look after them well. Oh, and if you wanted to take a look at the shoes in our store... you'd better make it quick.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
我们大概很快就要关门了。
 We'll probably be closing down, soon.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
为什么呢？
 Why is that?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
因为黑派大概会把我们赶出去。
 Because the Noirs'll probably evict us.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
红派正在走下坡路……我们的“声音”正变得越来越微弱、越来越飘忽。那些身居高位的红派，早就预见了这一天。
 Le Rouge is in decline... our Voice is growing increasingly faint and stretched. The higher Rouges already saw this coming a long time ago.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
迷失……又被抛弃……一次又一次。
 Lost... and abandoned... all over again.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
不过我倒不在意，因为我知道该怎么回家。
 But I don't mind, because I know how to get home.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
家？
 Home?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
对，家。就是我们所有人最初来的地方。我们每个人都曾有过一个家——我相信你们也一样。一个可以回去的地方，那里有人在等你回来。
 Yes, home. The place where we all came from. We each had one—and I'm sure you do, too. A place to return to, where people are waiting for you to come back.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text: 唔嗯！那辆巴士，便是吾等归处所在……确乎是一辆威风凛凛的巴士啊，小梅菲……而在那辆气派的巴士之中，尊贵的星红凝视大人——那位声名卓著的色彩收尾人……以及小卡戎，正等候吾等归来。 Hm! The bus! is our place to return to... Indeed, a bus! so grand and dashing, young Mephi... And within that handsome bus, Lord Red Gaze, a Color Fixer most illustrious... and young Charon await our return.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……唔……真是奇哉怪也！此事竟恍若千年前之旧事一般，朦胧难辨……
 ... Hoh... How peculiar! 'Tis as hazy as though I am speaking of events a millennium ago...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
哦，有意思。我还以为西西弗百货的居民，从不谈起来这里之前的生活呢。
 Oh, that's interesting. I thought the residents of the Grand Magasin never talked about their lives before coming here.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
确实如此，要成为这家百货商店的顾客，我们必须忘掉许许多多的事情。来这里之前的生活，我自己也几乎什么都不记得了。
 It's true, we do have to forget many, many things to become customers of this department store. I barely remember anything about the life I had before coming here.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
关于外面那个世界，我留存的唯一记忆……是一张哭泣的脸。法官的法槌敲下、判我西西弗刑罚的那一刻，我们四目相对——我看见泪水正顺着他们的脸颊滑落。
 The only memory I have left of the outside world... is the face of someone crying. When the judge's gavel hit the stand and sentenced me to the Sisyphe Penalty, our eyes met—and I saw tears streaming down their cheeks.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
啊，诚然如此……那法槌敲落时所蕴含的终局之感与沉重分量……着实足以令人潸然泪下。吾仍记得，当时那股冲击竟令吾眼前一片黯淡，恍若失明一般。
 Ah, verily... The finality and the weight behind the gavel as it hammered the stand... could bring tears to one's eyes. I recall feeling as though my vision had darkened from the sheer shock.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
你们想去的地方是哪里？
 Where is it that you seek to journey?
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
我们想去五楼。
 We're trying to get to the fifth floor.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
啊，太巧了……我知道怎么去五楼。我可以把这个秘密告诉你们……只要你们帮我找到回家的路。
 Ah, perfect... I know how to get to the fifth floor. I can share that secret with you... if you help me find my way home.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
<……！她知道怎么去五楼？！>
 <...! She knows how we can get to the fifth floor?!>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我们之前帮黑派办事的时候，她并没有对我们说过什么意义重大的话……她当时对我们来说，不过是鞋店的一个销售员而已。
 She didn't really say anything of much significance to us when we were helping the Noirs... She was just a sales rep at a shoe store, and that's all she was to us.

如果我们至今做出的种种不同选择，能为我们解锁五楼……或许我们能证明让娜是错的，走向一个不一样的结局。
 If the different choices we've made so far will unlock the fifth floor for us... maybe we can prove Jeanne wrong and bring us to a different end.

<告诉她，我们愿意帮忙。>
 <Tell her that we'll help.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……我们愿意帮忙。
 ... We will help.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
耶……好开心，好开心啊……
 Yay... Happy, so happy...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
你们听说过心脏碎片拖鞋的故事吗？那是一双活着的、还在跳动的鞋子，镶嵌着一枚泛着虹彩的红色心脏碎片。
 Ever heard the story about the Heartshard Slippers? A living, pulsing pair of shoes embedded with an iridescent red shard of heart.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
据说，把鞋跟碰响三下，就能带你回家……
 They say clapping its heels thrice will guide you home...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
我一直想做一双出来，材料我都齐了，可是……我一直找不到心脏碎片。
 I've been trying to make one, and I have all the materials, but... I've not been able to get my hands on the heart shard.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
我们上哪儿能找到心脏碎片呢……？
 Where can we get the heart shard...?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……我也不知道。以前这层楼有位浑身珠光宝气的人负责管理，他们的心脏特别漂亮……
 ... I don't know. There was this bejeweled person who used to manage this floor, and they had a beautiful heart...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
……不过他们前段时间不见了，已经好一阵子没人见过他们。
 ... But they disappeared some time ago, and haven't been seen in a while.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
他们真的是个乐善好施的灵魂……我还记得，他们从不吝啬跟大家分享自己的宝物。
 They really were a giving soul... I remember how they never hesitated to share their treasures with everyone.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
<乐善好施的灵魂……>
 <A giving soul...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……您能在家具馆找到他们。
 ... You will find them in the Furniture Hall.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
哦，真的吗……？那拜托了，帮我把心脏碎片找回来吧。
 Oh, really...? Then please, go find the heart shard for me.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
我就告诉你们怎么去五楼。
 And I'll tell you how to get to the fifth floor.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
等一下……那盏灯——他手上的东西比我们都多！
 Hang on a minute... that lamp—he's got way more stuff than we do!
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
……那你的脚趾甲，至少分我一点。我可不想落后。
 ... Gimme your toenails, at least. I don't wanna fall behind.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
还有那根拉线开关也交出来。
 And give up that pull switch, too.
texts.speaker:
人皮沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
都、都给我悠着点，各位。这根拉线开关可不是从——
 N-now hold your damn horses, everyone. This pull switch didn't come from—
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
然而他话还没说完，家具们便已经开始层层叠叠地扑了上去。
 But he doesn't get to finish his sentence as the Furnishings begin to pile onto each other.

喧闹声渐渐平息，一切动静也随之停止。只剩下一堆散架的家具。
 The racket eventually dies down, and all movements cease. Only a pile of broken Furnishings remain.

……哦……好一颗闪闪发光的心脏。而且还在跳动呢。
 ... Ooh... A glittering heart. It's still beating, too.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
有了这个……我就能做出带我回家的那双拖鞋了。
 With this... I can fashion the slippers that will take me home.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
你也会告诉我们怎么去五楼的吧？
 And you'll also tell us how to reach the fifth floor, yes?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
嗯……我回我的家，你们去你们的五楼。
 Mhm... I go home, and you go to the fifth floor.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
跟我来。
 Follow me.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
这儿，就是这儿。
 Here, here.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
……你们也听见了吧？
 ... You hear it too, don't you?
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
听、听见什么……？
 H-hear what...?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
那引领我们回家的低语声啊。你们没听见吗？鞋子里的心跳……正在加快。
 The whisper guiding us home. Don't you hear it? The heartbeat from the shoes—it's quickening.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
好了，就是这个地方……我要把鞋跟碰在一起了。三次。
 Now, this spot... is where I'll clap the heels together. Three times.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
*咔嗒* *咔嗒* *咔嗒*
 *tap* *tap* *tap*

随着鞋跟一次次相碰……
 As the heels of the shoes struck each other...

墙壁上出现了一个开口，通向某个未知的所在。
 An opening appeared in the wall, leading somewhere beyond.

汝当真确信……此乃通往汝家之路？
 Art thou certain... that this truly be thy homeward road?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
嗯。这里……是迷童中心。
 Mhm. This... is the Lost Child Center.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
是……在回家路上迷失的孩子们……聚集的地方……
 A gathering place... for children... lost on their way home...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
我需要那位乐善好施之魂的心脏，才能回家……
 I need the heart of the giving soul to go home...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
你们找到之后，能告诉我一声吗？
 Can you please let me know when you find it?
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
经理，那颗心脏很可能就在同一楼层的家具馆里。
 The heart is likely in the Furniture Hall on the same floor, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
我会在这儿等着的。
 I'll be waiting.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
一件形似鞋子的东西，被整整齐齐地摆放在那只异想体的残骸之上。
 Something resembling a pair of shoes was placed neatly atop the Abnormality's remains.

给，这就是……通往五楼的钥匙……
 There you go, the key... to the fifth floor...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
……你是明知会死，还来到这里的吗？
 ... You came here knowing that you'd die?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
啊……好甜的味道。
 Ah... What a sweet scent.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
我要……和那些迷失的孩子们……一起回到坟墓里去了……
 I will... go back to the grave... with the lost... children...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
欢迎光临！快请进。抱歉这里有点乱，我们才刚开张……所以正在重新粉刷内部。
 Welcome! Come right in. Excuse the mess; we've only just opened—so we've been repainting the interior.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
你们也看到了，要是墙纸底下总有那么多黑派在动来动去，那壁纸根本没法贴平整。这成品跟理想的室内设计相差甚远。
 As you can see, the wallpaper won't stick smoothly when too many Noirs keep moving beneath it. The finish is far from the ideal interior design, too.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
我们这个品牌嘛，说白了就是全新品牌。即便如此，我们最近还是跟六楼的模特布里昂德，完成了一次相当成功的联名合作。
 Our brand is, well, brand new. Despite that, we recently completed a successful collaboration with Briand, the model on the sixth floor.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
只要能确保这家店顺顺利利地开张，它没准会成为红派历来建成的最棒的手袋馆！
 If I can ensure this establishment opens without issues, it might become the best Handbags Hall that's ever been erected by the Rouges!
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
啊……贴墙纸……真是件令人愉悦的事……
 Ahh... Papering the wall... what a pleasing endeavor...
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
唔……通往电梯的路，似乎已被堵住了……
 Um... 'twould seem the path toward the escalator hath been blocked...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
那又有什么要紧的？重要的是墙纸贴上墙以后，能有多完美、多平整。
 And why should that matter? All that matters is how perfectly smooth the wallpaper will look once it's up on the walls.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
她真是沉浸在自己的工作里啊。
 She's really absorbed in her work.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<我们去跟旁边那位销售员聊聊看吧……>
 <Let's try speaking to the salesperson next to this one...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
哦，好吧。看来我们得再招个新店员了。看来下一个我不该再安排去贴墙纸了……
 Oh, well. We'll need to hire a new clerk. I suppose I shouldn't assign the next one to wallpapering...
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
如果需要帮忙找什么东西，尽管叫我。我们才刚开张，手袋系列都是全新的。
 Please call me up if you need help finding anything. We've just opened, so our handbags collection is brand-new.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
不用犹豫，尽管试试看，瞧瞧背在你身上是什么效果。
 Don't hesitate to try them and see how they look on you.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
……欢迎光临。
 ... Welcome.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
你……
 You...
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
……这位看起来是我的信徒。
 ... This one seems to be my follower.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
那是自然！打从我见到你的那一瞬间起，我体内的每一根血管，便只为你一人搏动。您的存在，令我心醉神迷……
 But of course! The instant I beheld you, all the blood vessels in my body started to thrum for no one else but you. Your presence fills me with rapture...
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
每一位自称虔诚的红派，都会珍视您、崇拜您，愿倾其所有，只为献给您一人。
 Every Rouge who calls themselves faithful will cherish you, worship you, and offer everything at their disposal only for you.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
……我知道。
 ... I know.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
尊贵的异乡人啊，请以最诚挚的敬意，照顾好我们最珍视的那一位。
 Honored strangers, please care for our most precious one with the utmost devotion.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
吾等自当如此。吾等甚至已为小布布备下一双鞋子。
 That we shall. We have even shod Young Pwie in a pair of shoes.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……我还有一事相求。蕾妮时常盯着墙壁自言自语。偶尔的自说自话当然无伤大雅；每位手袋设计师，天生都注定要在骨子里，苦苦思索设计这门伟大的两难课题。
 ... I have another request. Renée often mutters to herself while staring at the wall. A little self-directed discourse is harmless, of course; every handbag designer is fated to contemplate the great dilemma of design in the marrow of their bones.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer
