texts.text:
可蕾妮她，你们瞧……
 But Renée, you see...
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
她喜欢把脸贴在墙上，没完没了地念叨……简直没个停。我实在不想再当她那令人毛骨悚然的怪异举动的不情愿观众了。
 She likes to press her face against the wall and mutter without end... It's simply incessant. I'd like to stop being an unwilling audience to her hair-raising antics.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
起初，我还以为她是饿得受不了，才咬了墙壁一两口……结果并不是。她只是在把脸往墙上蹭而已。从不停下。
 At first, I thought she was taking a bite or two out of the wall, unable to contain her hunger... but no. She's simply rubbing her face against the wall. Never stops.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
可否劳烦你们，去查看一下她在墙里究竟看到了什么……又在跟谁说话？
 Would you be so kind as to inspect what she sees in the wall... and who she's speaking to?
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
等这事处理完……我想我便能清出通往电梯的路了。
 Once that's dealt with... I believe I can clear the path leading to the escalator.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
<有个声音……从墙壁里头传出来……>
 <There's a voice... coming from inside the wall...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
从阳光第一次照进这个地方开始，我便忠实地追随着它，从未间断。
 I've been following the sunlight faithfully from the first moment it reached out to this place.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
所以说，红派和黑派全都是一群蠢货，只顾着对黄金皮革痴迷不已，全然不顾未来。这家百货商店的崩塌，早在墙上出现裂缝的那一刻……便已注定。
 That's why the Rouges and the Noirs are both fools for obsessing over the Golden Hide without a care for the future. The collapse of the department store was sealed... when the cracks first appeared on the walls.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
如果你们打算把我赶出这家店……那至少让我把自己埋进这面洒满阳光的墙壁里吧。让我永远留在光里……
 If you're going to kick me out of the shop... at least let me bury myself in this sunlit wall. Let me remain in the light forever...
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
……异乡人们，你们怎么看？我是否该对这东西施以仁慈？
 ... What do you say, strangers? Ought I show this thing mercy?
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
我愿听从你们的判断。
 I will lend my ears to your judgment.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
我会把你埋进墙里。这将会是……你留下的最后一件室内作品。
 I'll bury you inside the wall. It will be... your final piece of interior work.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
谢谢你。我会在这里，沐浴着阳光等待，直到一切不可避免地风干为止……
 Thank you. I'll wait in here, basking in sunshine, until everything inevitably dries up...
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
不行，蕾妮。
 That's a no, Renée.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
我不能容许一个卑劣的虚无者继续活下去。
 I can't let a vile Néant live.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
……那就照你说的做吧。反正阳光……从不会轻视那些不追随它的人。
 ... You do that. The sunlight... never scorns those who do not follow it, anyway.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
它所求的一切，不过是等待……和拥抱。
 All it wants is to wait... and to embrace.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
……不用多久了，我的孩子们。
 ... It's not long now, my children.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
很快，你们就将作为这家百货商店里，最珍贵、最受宠爱的存在而诞生……
 Soon, you will be born as the most precious and beloved beings in this department store...
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
……你好。你知不知道这层楼的电梯要怎么走？
 ... Hello. Do you happen to know how to get to the escalator of this floor?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
无论我知不知道，对你们都没什么用处。搭电梯只会制造噪音。
 ... Whether or not I know, it would do you little good. Getting on an escalator only makes noise.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
那种金属摩擦的粗俗噪声，会啃噬我那些尚未完工的孩子们那纤细的心灵——存在越是美丽，就越敏感。而它们，唯有敏感这一点从不缺席。
 That vulgar grinding of metal gnaws at the delicate minds of my unfinished children—the more beautiful the being, the more sensitive it is. And they are nothing if not sensitive.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
汝方才言及孩子……？这些孩子究竟身在何处？
 Children, thou sayest...? Where be these children?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
它们很快就会苏醒。我的杰作，只由这家百货商店的黄金材料孕育而生。
 They will wake soon. My masterpieces, born only of this department store's golden materials.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
这已经是我第68次尝试了。这次必定会成功。68是个绝佳的数字。
 This is my 68th attempt. Surely it will succeed. 68 is an excellent number.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
我……不关心那个。
 I don't... care about that.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我想知道的是……电梯要怎么走。
 What I want to know is... how to get to the escalator.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……真是个讨人厌的小怪物。
 ... What a tiresome little abomination.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
唔，这倒是不失为个方便的法子。要想知道去那儿的路，就从那些四处游荡的人台身上，给我带些黄金材料来。
 Well, this might prove convenient. Bring me golden materials from the roaming mannequins if you wish to know the way there.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
把我要的东西凑够了带来，我或许就会告诉你们。
 Get me enough of what I ask for, and I may tell you.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
<……就按他说的做吧。>
 <... Let's do as he says.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我们带来了——
 We brought the—
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
啊，太好了！终于！
 Ahh, yes! At last!
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
<……他都没等我们说完，就直接抢走了。>
 <... He didn't even let us finish before grabbing them.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
金眼、金牙……还有金发。
 Golden Eye, Golden Tooth... and Golden Hair.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
好了，我的杰作们……你们可以睁开第68双眼睛了。
 Now, my masterpieces... You may open your 68th eyes.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
呃啊！那些丑八怪刺得我眼睛疼！爸爸，帮我挡住我的眼睛……
 Eeeek! Those uggos are burning my eyes! Shield my eyes, Papa...
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
我们……现在是最好的作品了吗……？
 Are we... the best pieces now...?
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
他所说的孩子……莫非便是那些包袋？
 The children he meant... were those bags?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
那些“丑八怪”，究竟又是何人？
 Who might these "uggos" be?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
我猜说的是我们。
 I think they mean us.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<又是我们进这家百货商店以来，一直收到的那些不请自来的时尚建议的又一变种……>
 <Just another variation of the unsolicited fashion advice we've been getting since entering this department store...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
来吧，我特许你们享有这份殊荣，得以亲眼一睹我的孩子们。
 Come, I shall grant you the special honor of laying eyes upon my children.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
这块布料，是我亲手一针一线缝制而成的。既结实，又耐用。
 This fabric was sewn stitch by stitch by my own hand. It's tough and resilient.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
嗯哼！我的皮肤很结实的。从来不会破。
 Mmhmm! My skin's tough. It never tears.
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
而这条曲线，则是以六楼那位模特的颈线为原型雕琢的——那可是吸引了无数目光的模特。
 And this curve was modeled after the neckline of a sixth-floor model—the model who drew the eyes of so many.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
我比昨天更值钱了，对吧，爸爸？
 I'm worth more than I was yesterday, aren't I, Papa?
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
那是自然。你的身价，与日俱增。
 Of course. Your value rises with every passing day.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
而这孩子的眼睛，则取自一面穿衣镜的碎片——那正是整个西西弗百货中，穿着最昂贵服饰的那位顾客所珍视的那面镜子。它浸透着那位顾客的渴望。
 And this child's eye is made from a shard taken from a full-length mirror—the very same one cherished by the customer who wore the most expensive attire in all of the Grand Magasin. It is saturated with that customer's longing.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
爸爸，为什么那些家伙看着我们，却不觊觎我们呢？
 Papa, why don't those things covet us when they look at us?
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
嘘，孩子。这些顾客，没资格拥有你。光是被允许看上一眼，对他们来说已是莫大的恩赐了。
 Shh, child. These customers are not worthy of possessing you. Merely being permitted to look is more than they deserve.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
……你们听见我孩子的话了吗？还有你们带着的那个东西，简直……骇人至极。务必确保它再也不会跟我的孩子们扯上关系。
 ... Did you hear my child? And that thing you're traveling with is... simply ghastly. Do ensure it never associates with my children again.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
你不是……“最好的”。
 You're not... "the best."
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我见过比这更闪亮的布料。
 I've seen fabric that shines brighter than this.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text: 不。那……不可能。比这个更闪亮？ No. That's... impossible. Brighter than this?
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
对呀，一匹织来把我撕碎的黄金面料。跟裹在那个大个子拳头上的，是同一种料子。
 Yeah, a bolt of Golden Fabric woven to rip me apart. It's the same fabric wrapped around that big one's fists.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……你们身上带着黄金织成的布料？
 ... You possess fabric made of gold?
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
……是的。
 ... Yes.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那位设计师，盯着缠在默尔索护手上的黄金面料，怔怔地呆立了仿佛长达数分钟之久，脸上写满了难以置信。
 For what felt like minutes, the designer stared blankly at the Golden Fabric wrapped around Meursault's gauntlet, disbelief written across his face.

我怎么会没注意到？你那袋子里透出的光……那是用异常纯净的黄金线织成的布料……真是华美绝伦……
 How could I have failed to notice that? That light inside your bag, it's... Fabric woven from exceptionally pure Golden Thread... Magnificent...
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
可是……我听说黄金线，只能用那些如今仅存于传说与故事中的珍稀材料织就……就算侥幸弄到了材料，也得在地下2层耗费无数个季节的等待，才能真正织成……
 But... I heard that the Golden Thread can be woven only from fabled materials now only passed down as tales and legends... That, even if you were to acquire them somehow, it would take countless seasons of waiting on B2 to truly complete it...
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
正因如此……我才从未见过有谁真正穿上过黄金面料。
 It's the reason... I have never once seen anyone wear Golden Fabric.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
……那么，构成我孩子们的材料……这一次，也依旧不是最上乘的。
 ... So the materials composing my children... were not the finest this time either.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
既然不是最好的……这一切便毫无意义……
 All of this is pointless... if you're not the best...
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
丑！不是用黄金线做的，就都是丑八怪！
 Ugly! Anything that isn't made from Golden Thread is ugly!
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
……我们又失败了吗，爸爸？
 ... Did we fail again, Papa?
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
最好的……到底什么时候？
 The best... When?
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
那位手袋设计师，开始缓缓勒紧他一直称之为孩子的那些包袋。
 The handbag designer slowly began to strangle the bags he had called his children.

这是何等丧尽天良的背叛？！竟要取那些唤汝为父之人的性命……！
 What is this heinous treachery?! To take the lives of those who call thee father...!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
不，它们不是我的孩子……！我的孩子，只能是最好的，而这些根本算不上！
 No, they're no children of mine...! My children are only the very best, and these are anything but!
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
这……这究竟是何等疯狂之举……？
 What... what madness this be...?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
你本该生来就每一处都是熠熠生辉的黄金材质……
 You should have been born with every part made of glittering, golden material...
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
嗝……丑八怪。丑……八怪……
 Ghk... uggo. Ug... go...
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
我……不想……死……爸……爸……
 I... don't want... to die... Pa... pa...
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
最好的……什么时候？……最好……的……
 The best... when? The... best...
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
堂吉诃德举起长枪，朝那位设计师冲了过去，然而……
 Don Quixote raised her lance and charged at the designer, but...

孩子们，有件事比活下去更重要。那便是……保持美丽。
 There is something more important than surviving, children. And it is... to remain beautiful.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
唔啊……！
 Ghh...!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……她的攻击毫无效果。在这片象征界中，唯有默尔索能够造成实质性的伤害。
 ... her attack amounted to nothing. Only Meursault was capable of causing physical harm in the Symbolic.

再稍等一下。我会找到比黄金面料更珍贵的东西……有了它，我这双手，便能孕育出西西弗百货有史以来最伟大的杰作……！
 Wait just a little longer. I'll find something even more precious than the Golden Fabric... And with it, my hands will birth the greatest masterpiece the Grand Magasin has ever known...!
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
怎……怎会有人如此歹毒……？
 How... could one be so wicked...?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……用了那么多珍贵材料创造出来的它们，在你眼里还是不够好。你到底……打算怎么做出比黄金面料更好的东西？
 ... All those precious materials that went into creating them, and they still weren't good enough for you. Just how... do you intend to make anything finer than the Golden Fabric?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……答案，或许就藏在地底最深处，比纺线的巢穴还要更深的地方……没错，据说那里正是红派最珍贵的兽皮被鞣制加工之处。
 ... Perhaps the answer to that lies in the deepest underground, beneath even the Nest where threads are spun... Yes, where they say the Rouges' most precious hides are tanned and processed.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
这一定是真的……那个被我当作长子提手用的红派，临死前正是喘着这个传闻咽的气。
 It has to be true... The Rouge I used as my firstborn's handle gasped that rumor with its dying breath.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
再说，有了丝线之后，自然该轮到皮革了。时尚之道，便是如此。
 Besides, after the thread comes the hide. Such is the way of fashion.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text: 无论要花上多少个季节……我一定会下去。我要亲手拿到那世间最顶级的兽皮……造出我此生所有孩子中最出色的一个！ No matter how many seasons it takes... I will descend. I'll get my hands on the finest hide out there... and create the best children I have ever had!
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
……我看我们说什么，现在都传不进你耳朵里了。
 ... I doubt anything we say will reach you now.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
但也许……你那“最完美”的孩子……正是你做的第一个包袋。
 But perhaps... your "most perfect" child... was the very first bag you ever made.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……胡说八道。走吧，去搭电梯吧……我就不劳烦相送了。
 ... Nonsense. Go, go take the escalator... I won't bother seeing you out.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
第69次尝试一定，一定会……
 The 69th attempt will surely, surely...
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
<……我们走吧。>
 <... We should go.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……他为什么要抛弃他们？
 ... Why did he abandon them?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
看来是没能像他期望的那样闪亮吧。我猜他不明白，这世上没有什么东西，能真正闪亮到配得上他的期望。
 Apparently they didn't shine as brightly as he wanted. I don't think he knows that nothing in the world can shine as brightly as his expectations.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……你们不能抛弃我。
 ... You can't abandon me.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
因为要是我想抵达我想要的地方……我可不能停下来。
 Because I can't afford to stop... if I'm to reach what I want.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
经理……不会抛弃您。
 The Manager... won't abandon you.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那你呢？
 What about you?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
吾虽不知小布布心中所欲为何……但恳请汝竭尽全力去追寻，汝之梦想终将开花结果！
 I know naught of thy desires, Young Pwie... But pray, endeavor with all thy heart, and thy dream shall bear fruit!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……不知道那算不算我的“梦想”。我都不知道“梦想”是什么。
 ... I dunno if it's my "dream." I don't even know what "dream" is.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
小布布，所谓梦想，便是那燃烧不息、驱动冒险精神的熊熊烈火！诚然，人或许会被那三重恐惧的噩梦所困，脚步为之滞留……
 A dream, Young Pwie, is the roaring fire that fuels the spirit of adventure! Verily, though one might dream nightmares of treble dread that tarry one's feet...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
然若汝能咬牙撑过每一场试炼，永不停息地向前冲锋……那汝终将抵达心之所向！
 Yet if thou endurest every trial and chargest ever onward... then thou shalt surely reach what thou desirest!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
你的梦想是什么……？
 What are your dreams...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
唔嗯！乃是成为一名最英勇无畏的收尾人……！呃，不过眼下嘛，吾等的梦想，应当是抵达这家百货商店的最高楼层。然而，唯有先将汝送至五楼之后，小布布……此事方能实现……
 Ahem! 'Tis to become a Fixer most valiant and ...! Uh, though at present, I suppose our dream is to reach the highest floor of this department store. However, that will come to pass only after we take thee to the fifth floor, Young Pwie...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
我不懂。
 I don't get it.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
把我送到那儿以后，就没有“然后”了。
 There isn't an "after" once you take me there.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
你们得跟我一起留在五楼。
 You have to stay with me on the fifth floor.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
<……看来小布布不想说再见啊。>
 <... Looks like little Pwie doesn't wanna say goodbye.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
小布布……与汝分别，吾等亦深感不舍——然而，吾等终究无法永远滞留于五楼之上啊。
 Young Pwie... we too would be loath to part with thee—alas, we cannot linger on the fifth floor for all eternity.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
为什么……？是因为你想念“猩红凝视大人”……还有……那个你叫“小卡戎”的人吗？
 Why...? Is it because you miss "Lord Red Gaze"... and... the person you call "Young Charon"?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
唔……此言诚然，倒也并非全然有误……
 Hmm... that is not entirely wrong, forsooth...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……你们就不能跟我待在一起吗？
 ... Can't you just stay with me?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我们在这家百货商店外面，还有很多事要做。所以……布布，我想我们没法永远陪着你。
 We have a lot of things to do outside this department store. So... I don't think we can stay with you forever, Pwie.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
那……
 Then...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
要是你们没有那些“要做的事”……我们就能一直在一起了吗？
 If you didn't have those "things to do"... we'd stay together?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
吾恐此等日子，终究难以到来……
 I doubt such a day shall ever arrive...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
然而，若真有那么一日到来，届时汝亦可随吾等同行，一路相伴左右！
 But should it arrive, then thou canst accompany us and remain by our side instead!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
我说不准堂吉诃德的这番回答，对布布来说是否足够满意，但布布没有再多问什么，只是默默地走到默尔索身后，站定了下来。
 I couldn't say for sure whether Don Quixote's answer was good enough for them, but Pwie asked no more questions and quietly took their place behind Meursault.

看来你们也找到了那“声音”。
 So you found the Voice, too.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
好温暖啊……是不是？
 It's so very warm... isn't it?
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
啊……我感觉自己可以就这样，永远待下去。
 Aah... I feel I could remain like this forever.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
我想把整个身子都塞进这道裂缝里，一直待在那儿，聆听着这“声音”，沐浴着这份温暖，直到那一天到来……
 I want to wedge my whole body into this crack and stay there, listening to the Voice and basking in the warmth until the day arrives...
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
……看来吾等之言语，全然传不进她耳中。
 ... It seemeth our words do not at all reach them.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
她把自己往墙上蹭个不停，浑然不觉那早已坏死的皮肉，正随着摩擦从她脸颊和耳朵上一点点剥落下来。
 She rubs herself against the wall, oblivious to the dead flesh sloughing off her face and ears from the friction.

这位不是我的信徒。
 This one is not my follower.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
她侍奉的是别的什么东西……
 She serves something else...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
你们查清她到底——啊！
 Did you discover what she—aah!
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
你以为自己在干什么？！快把脸从墙上拿开！
 What do you think you're doing?! Get your face off the wall!
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
别插手……别把我从这份安宁的歇息中拽出来……
 Don't interfere... don't pull me away from that peaceful rest...
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
真没想到，一个可怕的虚无者，竟藏在我们店里……
 To think a horrendous Néant was hiding in our establishment...
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
我们……无处不在。我们只等待着阳光淹没整个西西弗百货的那一天……
 We... are everywhere. We await only the day the sunlight will flood the Grand Magasin...
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
等那一天到来，我们便会脱下这身令人窒息的衣物外皮，坐在西西弗百货那片废墟的残骸之上，沐浴在那将我们温柔拥入怀中的阳光里。
 And when that day arrives, we'll cast off this suffocating skin of clothes and sit on the debris of the Grand Magasin's ruin, basking in the sunlight that will take us in its warm embrace.
texts.speaker:
蕾妮
 Renée

texts.text:
……你。你是什么时候叛变到他们那边去的？
 ... You. When did you defect to their side?
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
虚无者们……是在百货商店出现裂缝后不久便出现的。他们把自己隐藏起来，阴险地混迹在我们之中。
 The Néants... appeared soon after the cracks formed in the department store. They conceal themselves and blend in among us insidiously.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
他们表面上看起来跟我们没什么两样，可他们真正的目的，却在别处。
 They may seem to behave like us on the surface, but their true objective lies elsewhere.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
哦，好吧。看来我们得再招个新店员了。看来下一个我不该再安排去贴墙纸了……
 Oh, well. We'll need to hire a new clerk. I suppose I shouldn't assign the next one to wallpapering...
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
通往五楼的电梯，就在黑派手袋馆那边，穿过那位设计师工作的地方就到了。
 The escalator to the fifth floor is past Le Noir's Handbags Hall where its designer works.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
我听说那位设计师早就疯了，一心痴迷于要做出世间最伟大的包袋。
 I hear that designer lost his mind ages ago and became obsessed with creating the greatest bag in existence.
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
不过他不过是个黑派罢了，我对他也没抱太大希望……
 Though I don't have high hopes, him being a mere Noir and all...
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
一边……想一直守护黄金，
 One side... wants to keep protecting the Golden,
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
另一边……想一直剥下黄金来吃掉。
 and the other side... wants to keep peeling off and eating the Golden.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
他们互相憎恨，想要的东西还完全相反。这是为什么？
 They hate each other, and what they want is completely opposite. Why is that?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
那是……铭记的欲望，与体验的欲望之间的冲突。
 That is... a conflict between the desire to remember and the desire to experience.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
铭记的欲望，是一种将某种珍贵之物原封不动地保存下来，并尽可能长久留存的冲动。
 The desire to remember is the impulse to preserve something of value as it is and retain it for as long as possible.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
体验的欲望，则是一种预先期盼那份价值，继而将其消耗殆尽，好让自己亲身经历一番的冲动。
 The desire to experience is the impulse to anticipate that value, then consume it and undergo the experience for oneself.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
这家百货商店，正是这两种冲动分道扬镳、各自走向极端后形成的生态。
 The department store is an ecosystem in which those two impulses have diverged and been driven to the extremes.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
铭记，还有体验……
 Memory, and experience...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
你选的是哪一个？
 Which one did you choose?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……这是个很难回答的问题。
 ... That is a difficult question.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
我不认为有必要在两者之间做出选择。
 I do not believe it is required to choose between them.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
可要是有一天，你被逼着非选不可呢？
 But suppose one day you're forced to?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……那我的答案会是，我不知道。
 ... I would answer that I do not know.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
为什么不知道？
 Why don't you know?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……等我找到答案的那天……我会告诉您的。
 ... I will let you know... if I arrive at an answer.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
这台电梯出故障了。或许在四楼做点什么，就能让它重新运转起来。
 This escalator is out of order. Maybe there's something we could do on the fourth floor to get it moving again.

这里还有未完成的事情。
 There are remaining tasks here.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
（没有任何动静。只剩下被洗劫过的残骸。）
 (There's no movement. Only remnants of the pillaging remain.)
texts.speaker:
快乐衣橱
 Happy Closet

texts.text:
（在破碎家具的残骸之间，能看见一团凝结成块的红色物体。）
 (Between the remnants of broken furniture, a red, congealed lump can be seen.)
texts.speaker:
快乐衣橱
 Happy Closet

texts.text:
唔……？这是什么……？
 Hmm...? What's this...?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<那……心脏。>
 <The... heart.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……这位明明什么都不想拿。
 ... This one didn't want to take anything.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
那为什么，他们还是落得这个下场？
 So why did this happen to them?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
一片寂静。仿佛什么都不曾发生过。
 It's quiet. Like nothing had happened.

……有股花香……
 ... It smells of flowers...
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
但愿我们都能，无声无息地消失就好了……
 If only we can all vanish without a trace...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
但愿我们都能，回归尘土就好了……
 If only we can all return to the earth...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
那样，我就能再见到那张脸了……那个为我哭泣的人。
 Then I'll get to see their face again... The one who wept for me.
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
紫罗兰的花瓣，会带我们所有人回家……
 The violet petals will take us all back home...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text: <这里头竟然有个异想体……？> Abnormality in here...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
经理，她还没有告诉我们该怎么去五楼。
 She... has not yet informed us how to reach the fifth floor, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……她被带去那边了。更深处。
 ... She was taken that way. Deeper in.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
那吾等只需继续深入，前去救援便可！
 Then we need only venture further to her aid!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……这对你们来说，可能也很危险。
 ... This might be dangerous for you, too.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
诚哉斯言，因凡冒险，皆非毫无风险之举！
 Verily, I say, for no adventure is without peril!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
我们用剪刀，把黄金皮革从墙上剪了下来。
 We used the scissors to cut the Golden Hide from the wall.

能断断续续地听见痛苦的哭泣声。
 Pained weeping can be heard intermittently.

这面墙还在风干中。
 The wall is still drying.

<通往电梯的路被堵住了。>
 <The way to the escalator is blocked.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
先探查一下附近的店铺，比较合理。
 It would be reasonable to explore the nearby stores first.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
这是什么？
 What's this?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
啊～这是花盆！植物的家。
 Ah~ This is a pot! A home for plants.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
能吃吗？
 Can I eat it?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
如果你说的是花盆，那……不行，一般来说不能吃。
 If you're talking about the pot, then... no, they're generally inedible.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
若汝所言乃植物，那自然是能吃的！一般说来皆可食用！
 If thou speakest of the plant, then indeed! They are generally edible!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
好吃吗？
 Do they taste good?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
唔……那得看是什么植物。
 Hmm... That would depend on the plant.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
听到这话，布布从植物上摘下了一片叶子……
 Hearing that, Pwie plucked a leaf off the plant...

……然后一口吞了下去。
 ... and swallowed it.

小、小布布，味道如何？
 H-how does it taste, young Pwie?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……有点苦。
 ... Bit bitter.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
唔……那便容吾轻轻以舌尖一舔……
 Hm... Then allow me but the lightest dab of the tongue...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……哦嚯！倒是颇为芳香！
 ... Oho! 'Tis quite fragrant!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
*干呕*
 *gag*
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……堂吉诃德接下来好一阵子，都在不停干呕反胃。
 ... Don Quixote continued to gag and retch for a while.

有什么东西正沐浴在阳光下。
 There's something basking in the sun.

默尔索捡起了那双发光鞋。
 Meursault picked up the Luminous Shoes.

墙上落着一小片阳光。阳光下方，散落着几件来自“快乐衣橱”库存的物品。
 There's a patch of sunlight falling on the wall. Beneath it are a few items from the Happy Closet's inventory.

还真是灯下黑啊。
 It really is dark under the candlestick, huh?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
经理阁下，吾等是否该将这些一并带走？
 Shall we take these with us, Manager Esquire?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<好，就这么办吧。>
 <Sure, let's do that.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
一盆看起来相当健康的植物。
 A rather healthy-looking pot of plant.

叶片正在风中轻轻摇曳。话说这风到底是从哪儿吹来的？
 The leaves are swaying softly in the wind. Where's the wind blowing from, anyway?

这层楼的什么地方，是不是有家手袋店？
 Is there a handbag shop somewhere on this floor?

这张长椅看起来，要是坐太久，腰肯定会疼。
 This bench looks like it'd hurt the back to sit on for too long.
笃、笃、笃。刷、刷、刷。有节奏的敲击声，紧接着是扫帚扫地的声音。 Tap tap tap. Swish swish swish. Rhythmic tapping followed by brooms sweeping the floor.

那声音现在变轻了，听起来像是从远处传来的。
 The sound has gotten quieter now, as though it's coming from afar.

那不祥的吱嘎声停了下来。
 The ominous creaking came to a stop.

那刺耳的吱嘎声停了下来。
 The strident creaking came to a stop.

……径直朝自己内部塌陷了下去。
 ... Sank right into itself.

一具红派的尸体。那些鞋子，一双也没能帮他们逃出去。
 The corpse of a Rouge. All those shoes did nothing to help them escape.

驼背落地灯，是否曾料到会落得这般下场？
 Was the Arc Floor Lamp ready for such an end?

它再也不会为谁照明，也不会再挂上任何东西了。
 It'll never illuminate or hang anything again.

一滩红色的血泊，正从它那浸满鲜血、支离破碎的躯干缓缓扩散开来。即便是阳光，也不足以晒干这么多血。
 A red puddle slowly spreads from its bloodsoaked, broken body. Even the sunlight isn't bright enough to dry all that blood.

本以为死亡会将它们分开，谁知却把它们纠缠得更紧了。
 Thought death would do them part, but it's only tangled them closer together.

这滩血肉模糊的东西，恐怕再也没人会买了。
 Doubt anyone's going to buy this pile of bloody mess, now.

床架已经彻底碎裂。已经算不上一张能用的床了。
 The frame is completely shattered. It doesn't make for a very good bed anymore.
[미사용] <시체인 것 같다.>

到头来，他既没有孩子为他的死哀悼，也没有留下什么杰作，能让这世界记住他。
 In the end, he has no children to mourn his demise, nor masterpieces for the world to remember him by.

掀开墙上没被贴住的那部分，露出一个敞开的通风口。虽然狭窄，但我们大概能爬得进去。
 Lifting the uncovered part of the wall reveals an open vent. It's narrow, but we could probably crawl through it.

但这个洞口，深处延伸进了一片难以看透的黑暗。
 But the hole extends into impenetrable darkness.

<color=#ebcaa2>还记得这个地方吗？我们很久以前建的。毕竟一家百货商店，总得有一两个访客在这迷宫里迷路才像话……</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Remember this place? We had it built long ago. Can't have a department store without a visitor or two getting lost in its mazes, after all...</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>就跟你带在身边的那个小流浪儿一样。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Much like the little stray you've taken along.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>一个由西西弗百货本身孕育而生的存在……不知道那东西长大后，会不会像红派所期望的那样，成为我们这样的巨人？说不定，它还会找到你母亲曾经坐过的那个位置呢？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>A being born of the Grand Magasin itself... I wonder if that thing'll grow up to become a Giant like us, as the Rouges intended? Perhaps it'll find a seat where your mother used to sit?</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>……好在，那位首脑还没踹开这地方的门找过来……看来他决定不追究那孩子的存在了。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>... Well, at least the Head hasn't come kicking this place's door down yet... Which means it decided not to take issue with that kid's existence.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>你觉得这是为什么？是不是因为那东西反正也没法在西西弗以外存在？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Why do you think that is? Is it because that thing can't exist outside Sisyphe anyway?</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>说起来，你有没有想过这件事？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Say, have you ever thought about it?</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>我是说，死亡，还有对死亡的厌恶。这不过是种再自然不过的反应，不是吗？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Death, I mean, and the aversion to it. It's a perfectly natural response, isn't it?</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>所以才会有那么多条件，得先满足了才能买到含有残酷与暴力内容的罐头体验。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>That's why there are numerous requirements to satisfy before one can purchase Canned Experiences containing cruelty and violence.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>好了，说点值得琢磨的——你有没有想过，为什么性，跟死亡一样，也会招致类似的厌恶与审查？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Now then, some food for thought—have you ever wondered why sexuality, like death, provokes similar aversion and censorship?</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>答案想必有很多种……不过这是我的答案。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>There are many possible answers, I'm sure... But here's mine.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>我们之所以既恐惧又厌恶生育与死亡，是因为……说到底，孕育某样东西，跟杀死它并没有什么不同。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>We're afraid of and revolted by both procreation and death because... at the end of the day, birthing something is no different from killing it.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>要我说，把某个人带进这个世界——强迫他们出生——本就是一种纯粹的暴力，跟谋杀一样，都是极不负责任的行径。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>I say inviting someone into this world—forcing them to be born—is pure violence, an act as grossly irresponsible as murder.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>所以说，就是这样。在一个人毫不知情的情况下，把他拖进这个世界，又把他从世界上带走——这两者，都丝毫没有尊重过他的意愿。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>So, there it is. Dragging someone into the world unawares, and removing them from it—neither has an ounce of respect for their volition.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>本质上，它们是同一件事。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>They're fundamentally the same thing.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>人类凭本能就知道这一点。可正因如此，才会带来那种不谐感的痛苦。因为这与我们的天性相冲突——那种为了延续种族，不惜一切代价的天性。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Humans know this by instinct. But that is precisely what causes the pain of dissonance. Because it clashes with our nature, which is hardwired to do anything for the preservation of our species.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>这也是为什么生与死的概念，会同时既令人恐惧又令人着迷。我们生来如此——身为人类，便意味着总会被那禁忌之物所诱惑，想去玩弄它。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>This is why the ideas of birth and death are both so terrifying and alluring at the same time. It's simply how we're made—to be human is to be tempted to play with what is taboo.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>红派一直在排泄。在孕育。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>The Rouges are perpetually excreting. Birthing.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>黑派则完全不想沾染这些。他们既不想孕育任何东西，也不愿体验死亡。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>The Noirs want no part in any of that. They don't want to give birth to anything, nor do they wish to experience death.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>然后……当当！这就是西西弗百货，在我眼中的样子：</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>And... Ta-da! This is what the Grand Magasin is to me:</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>一个欲望毫无节制地膨胀、爆裂，被摆出来展览的地方。这里的一切，都待价而沽。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>A place where desire swells and bursts with no restraint, put on exhibit. Everything is for sale here.</color>

你们这些肮脏的贱民，竟敢对我动手！
 How dare you filthy plebeians lay your hands on me!
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
我真不该把你们当作同伴看待。
 I should never have considered you as allies.
texts.speaker:
单脚人
 One-leg

texts.text:
求你们别这样。我到底做了什么？
 Please don't do that. What did I ever do to you?
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
我只是想回家……
 I just want to go home...
texts.speaker:
多罗西娅
 Dorothea

texts.text:
……人都会犯错。我就当这是一次失误吧……
 ... Everyone makes mistakes. I'll consider this as one...
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
你们是想把我弄坏吗？拜托，住手吧。
 Are you trying to destroy me? Please, stop this.
texts.speaker:
驼背落地灯
 Arc Floor Lamp

texts.text:
哦不！我的第2节颈椎！
 Oh no! My L2 vertebra!
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text:
啊啊！你把我全身的关节都打散了！
 Arrgh! You're breaking all of my joints!
texts.speaker:
挂骨衣架
 Bonehanger

texts.text: 伙计。这次我会酷~一点的，别再来了。 Dude. I'll be kewl~ this time, so don't do it again.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text: 酷~一点吧，兄弟们……要是把我的帘子撕破了，就没人会买我了。 Be kewl, my dudes... No one's gonna buy me if you make a rip in my curtains.
texts.speaker:
剥制皮革帘
 Taxidermied Leather Curtain

texts.text:
啊咧！你正好打中我最敏感的地方了！
 Ach! You just hit my sensitive spot!
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
哎哟！不买我就别打我啊！
 Ow! Don't hit me if you're not even gonna buy me!
texts.speaker:
红垫凳
 Red-cushioned Stool

texts.text:
*哈欠*哎哟……好疼……可唔……想阻止你，也太麻烦了……
 *yawn* Oww... it hurts... But ugh... It's trying to stop you is such a bother...
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
又想哄我睡觉吗？
 Are you trying to put me to sleep again?
texts.speaker:
软皮革床
 Mellow Leather Bed

texts.text:
嗷呜！
嗷呜！
 Owie!
Owie!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
好疼！
好疼！
 It hurts!
It hurts!
texts.speaker:
双子台灯
 Lamp Twin

texts.text:
啊，求你们住手……
 Ah, please stop...
texts.speaker:
人皮沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
我说了住手，你们这群该死的混账东西！
 I SAID STOP, YOU GODDAMN SHITBIRDS!
texts.speaker:
人皮沙发
 Skinhide Couch

texts.text:
难看又丑陋的蠢货们……你们以为自己在干什么？！
 Unsightly, ugly fools... What do you think you're doing?!
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
我必须……造出我的第70件杰作……可是……我做出来的全都是……失败品……
 I have to... make my 70th masterpiece... But... all that I've made are... failures...
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
他们忙着填补墙上的裂缝，连头都没回来看我们一眼。
 So busy filling the cracks on the wall, they don't even turn around to look at us.

等等，住手！你、你是想从我这儿要什么吗？告诉我你想要什么就行……！
 Wait, stop! I-is there something you want from me? Just tell me what you want...!
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
可是……我才刚刚直面那“声音”……
 But... I've only just now faced the Voice...
texts.speaker:
红派手袋馆设计师
 Le Rouge Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
布布把手搭在了一张沙发上。
 Pwie rested their hand on a couch.

<……！默尔索！抓住布布！>
 <...! Meursault! Grab Pwie!>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
怎、怎么了……？
 Wh-what...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
我是不是做错了……什么？
 Did I do something... wrong?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
您没有做错什么。只是……随便碰这里的东西，可能会引发……麻烦。
 You did not. But... laying your hands on random objects in here could cause... problems.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
诚哉斯言！因此举或将招致其主人之怒！
 Verily! For doing so may anger its owner!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
它有主人……？我不知道。没人买它，所以……我以为它没有主人。
 It has an owner...? I didn't know. Nobody bought it, so... I thought it didn't have one.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……确、确实如此。然而——
 ‘Tis… true. Yet…
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
布布向我们抛来了一连串问题。
 Pwie barraged us with questions.

啊，小布布！汝之偏好，莫非是这一侧的鞋子？
 Ah, young Pwie! Dost thy preference lean toward shoes on this side?
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
比起另一边的，我更喜欢这些。
 I like 'em more than the ones on the other side.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text: 但也算不上特别喜欢这些…… But I don't like like these...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
小布布，汝有此般迟疑，实属情理之中！寻觅那双完美之鞋的旅程，着实艰辛无比！
 'Tis fair to harbor such doubt, young Pwie! The journey for the perfect pair of shoes is most arduous indeed!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
啊哈！汝莫非中意这一双？且看这鞋头之锐利棱角，还有此处这可拉动之绑带，用以防止鞋带松脱时那最令人遗憾的意外！
 Aha! Dost thou enjoy this pair of shoes, perchance? Behold the sharp angle of the toe cap, and the pullable band hither to prevent most unfortunate accidents when its strings are undone!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……不知道。
 ... I dunno.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
如此甚好！那便容吾为汝介绍这一双——
 Very well! Then allow me to introduce these—
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
堂吉诃德接连为布布展示了各式各样的鞋子，但布布似乎都没什么兴趣。
 Don Quixote continued to showcase various shoes for Pwie, but none of those seemed to interest them much.

这个是不是跟一楼那些扭曲的人台一样……是用来向顾客展示这款包袋从各种角度背起来是什么样子的……？
 I wonder if this one's like the contorted Mannequins on the first floor...? To demonstrate to customers how this bag can be worn at every angle...?

这边的柱子还完好无损，跟对面那些不一样。
 The pillars here are intact, unlike the ones on the other side.

跟走廊里展示的那个手袋，是同一款设计。
 Same design as the handbag displayed in the corridor.

……它动了。
 ... It moved.

【谢瓦利耶：一件承载着黑派手袋馆全部历史的器物，自西西弗百货创立之初，便一直引领着手袋设计这门艺术。】
 [Chevalier : A objet containing the total history of Le Noir Handbags Hall, which has spearheaded the art of handbag design since the Grand Magasin Sisyphe's inception.]

<……嘿，这个看起来挺有艺术感的。>
 <... Hey, this one looks artsy.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
哦哦哦！虽较之吾心爱的驽骍难得略逊一筹，然亦不失为一匹良驹！
 Ooooh! Though it paleth before dearest Rocinante, 'tis an excellent steed indeed!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<……我怎么觉得，那匹马刚才瞪了你一眼？>
 <... I think the horse just glared at you?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
还、还望恕罪，小小的……木马良驹啊。恕吾方才……失言无状。
 P-prithee, accept mine apologies, young steed of... wood. Forgive my... comment most foolish.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
它没有任何回应。
 It does not reply.

【谢瓦利耶：一件承载着黑派手袋馆全部历史的器物，自西西弗百货创立之初，便一直引领着手袋设计这门艺术。】
 [Chevalier : A objet containing the total history of Le Noir Handbags Hall, which has spearheaded the art of handbag design since the Grand Magasin Sisyphe's inception.]

布布对这些东西似乎完全提不起兴趣。
 Pwie seems completely disinterested in these.

一个干净整洁、摆放有序的手袋展示柜。
 A clean and nicely organized handbags display.

里面装着各式手袋保养工具。看起来没必要拿走这些。
 Contains various tools for handbag maintenance. Seems unnecessary to take these.

有什么东西掉在了柱子后面。
 Something's fallen behind the pillar.

【……设计师……似乎……不会加入进来。】
 [... Designer... not joining... it seems.]

【未发现阻碍要素。将……与……其他……】
 [No obstructive elements found. Will... with... other...]

有几处字迹已被抹去。
 Erased in a few places.

【被容纳的蜕落：唯有蜕去，方能最终被容纳。】
 [Contained Shedding: By shedding, one finally contains.]

【被容纳的蜕落：唯有蜕去，方能最终被容纳。】
 [Contained Shedding: By shedding, one finally contains.]

有什么东西掉在了展示台底下。地上散落着几缕松脱的丝线。
 Something has fallen beneath the display stand. A few loose strands of thread lie on the floor.

银色的丝线，与漆黑色的丝线……在它们之间，一缕黄金纤维正在空中飘荡。
 Silver-threaded strands and pitch-black ones... and between them, a single Golden Fiber drifts in the air.

展示中的手袋上，薄薄地蒙着一层灰尘。
 There's a light powdering of dust over the handbag on display.

一根倒下的柱子。看起来已经倒了有一阵子了。
 A fallen pillar. Looks like it's been that way for a while.

一桶……肉揉成的面团。
 Dough of... flesh in a bucket.

这个应该挺适合布布的。
 This'll look good on Pwie.

一些小巧的包袋。这些装不下多少东西。
 Tiny bags. These won't hold much.

一片片垂挂的血肉帘幔，已经侵占了展示柜。
 Hanging curtains of flesh have invaded the display cases.

一盆看起来相当健康的植物。
 A rather healthy-looking pot of plant.

这张长椅看起来，要是躺太久，腰肯定会疼。
 This bench looks like it'd hurt the back to lie down on for too long.

啊，是滑梯～！大概是给孩子们玩的地方吧？
 Ah, a slide~! A place for children, maybe?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
滑梯是什么？
 What's a slide?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text: 是种游乐设施。你从一边爬梯子上去，再从另一边的斜坡嗖——地滑下来。 It's a playground ride. You climb the ladders on one side, and sliiiide down the decline on the other side.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
布布，要不要试试看？
 Would you like to give it a try, Pwie?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
我不喜欢往下滑……
 I don't like going down...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
其实比你想的要好玩多了～
 It's more fun than you might think~
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
诚然如此，布布！吾从未见过哪个孩子不爱滑梯。恳请汝去滑上一滑！
 Indeed, Pwie! Not once have I met a child who disliketh the slide. Prithee, give it a slide!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<我们时间不多了，各位……要不等以后再来玩？>
 <We don't have much time, guys... How about we come back to it later?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
求求了，经理阁下！只需片刻工夫即可！
 Prithee, Manager Esquire! It will only take but a moment!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<……好吧。反正也就是个滑梯。>
 <... Fine. It's just a slide, after all.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
来，小布布……从这一侧爬上去，然后——啊，务必把双腿向前伸直！让斜坡把汝的身子送下去……
 Now, young Pwie... climb from this side, and—ah, be sure to stretch both of thy legs forward! And allow the declining path to carry thee...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
……如吾方才所示范这般！！
 ... as I have demonstrated!!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
从这边爬上去，然后……
 Climb... from this side, and...
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……挺好玩的。
 ... That was fun.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
看你玩得开心，我也很开心～
 Watching you have fun makes me happy, too~
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
……我能再玩一次吗？
 ... Can I go again?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
<……行啊，有何不可。>
 <... Why not.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
经理已经批准了。您可以再玩一次。
 The manager has given their authorization. You may go again.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
哇。
 Woo.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
布布蹦蹦跳跳、开开心心地又跑上了滑梯的顶端。
 Pwie happily bounced up the stairs to the top of the slide once again.

我还要玩。我还要玩。
 I wanna go again. I wanna go again.
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
……经理。
 ... Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<……我们大概该出发了。>
 <... We should probably get going.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
经理阁下，此言非为异议……然汝可曾瞧见，这活动带给这孩子多大的欢愉？只需再让他玩上这最后一次，吾等便即刻启程赶路。
 'Tis not to disagree with thee, Manager Esquire... Yet hast thou not seen how much joy this activity granteth the child? Just once more, and we shall carry on with haste.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
布布蹦蹦跳跳、开开心心地又跑上了滑梯的顶端。
 Pwie happily bounced up the stairs to the top of the slide once again.

……布布连问都没问，又跑向了滑梯顶端。
 ... Pwie runs to the top of the slide again without even asking us.
<……呃……各位，我们真的该……> <... Uh... Guys, we really gotta...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
您以后还可以再玩。
 You can ride it some more later.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
以后……？什么时候？
 Later...? When?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
到头来，我们还是由着布布，把滑梯玩了个尽兴。
 In the end, we let Pwie play as much as they wanted.

……真有这么好玩吗？
 ... Is it really that fun?

但丁，你是不是……也想玩滑梯？
 Did you... want to go on the slide too, Dante?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
经理，您该不会现在就想去玩滑梯吧？
 Are you thinking of riding the slide right now, Manager?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
没什么好玩的。
 It's not much fun.

在抽屉里发现了一张纸。
 Found a piece of paper inside the drawer.

【寻人启事】
 [MISSING PERSON]

【特征：脸上有烧伤疤痕，戴围巾，背皮包……】
 [Description: Burn scar on the face, scarf, leather bag...]

【最后目击地点：西西弗广场，1楼，××纪念馆】
 [Last Seen: Plaza Sisyphe, 1F, ■■■ Memorial Hall]

<……烧伤疤痕？>
 <... Burn scar?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
你认识的人？
 Someone you know?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<……说不定吧。不过，西西弗广场在哪儿？>
 <... Maybe. Where's Plaza Sisyphe, though?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
默尔索什么都没说。他盯着那张纸看了一会儿，似乎陷入了沉思，随后摇了摇头，仿佛在说自己也不知道。
 Meursault said nothing. He stared at the paper for a moment, seemingly lost in thought, then shook his head as if to say he didn't know.

大部分文件，都是在寻找特定顾客的启事。我们刚才看到的那张，是最后一张在寻找“人”的启事。
 Most of the documents are notices searching for particular customers. The one we saw earlier was the last one looking for a "person."

……真心希望这不是真的。
 ... I truly hope this isn't true.

PA室的骰子，难道一路滚到这儿来了？
 Did the dice from the PA Room roll all the way down here?

一枚没什么用、却沉甸甸的骰子。
 A useless, heavy die.

积木搭成了房子的形状。
 Blocks assembled like a house.

试着推了推，但它没有倒塌。已经被牢牢固定住了。
 Tried pushing on it, but it doesn't crumble. It's been solidly fixed.

跟踪了一阵子后，好不容易才抓住了它——它不停地四处乱窜。
 Barely managed to catch it from scampering all over the place after tailing it for a while.

这东西横冲直撞、毫无方向，好不容易才抓住。
 Barely managed to catch this thing blindly running amok.

好不容易才揪住它的胡须抓到了它。它每次跑动，都会留下一道长长的痕迹……
 Barely managed to catch this thing by its whiskers. It always left a long streak as it ran...

一片原本浓密光泽的毛发，如今枯萎散落在地，已失去所有生气。
 A patch of once-luscious hair lies scattered on the ground withered, having lost all of its vibrance.

它的牙齿，已经被磨成了细小的碎片。
 It has ground its teeth to tiny shards.

它的眼球，已经从眼窝里迸裂挤出。
 Its eyeball has popped and squeezed out of the skull.

这些裂开的缝隙，不会再被重新填补了。
 The open cracks won't be filled again.

这里不卖裹尸袋。
 They don't sell bodybags here.

怀揣着回家的心愿，她被安葬在花瓣的覆盖之下，长眠于那些同样迷失的孩子们身旁。
 With the wish of returning home nestled deep within her heart, she's been laid to rest beneath a burial of flower petals next to all those who are lost.

一具红派的尸体。血液已在那只脱落的鞋子里积成了一滩。
 The corpse of a Rouge. Blood has pooled in the shoe that fell off.

几个看起来像是手袋的东西，屏息静默地伫立着，一动不动。
 Handbag... -looking things are sitting still in silent, bated breath.

显然，比起展示柜上的那些其他货色，这几件的制作，明显倾注了更多的心血。
 Clearly, much more care has gone into making these than the other ones on display.

别害羞！见证我这觉醒孩子们的完美吧。
 Don't be shy! Witness the perfection that is my awakened children.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
<我们只需踩着花瓣走就行。说来也怪，花瓣底下好像不会再开出新花来。>
 <We need to tread only over the flower petals. Strangely enough, flower doesn't seem to bloom from under them.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
此举确解一难，唉，然沿途尚有诸多其他困扰……
 That addresseth one issue indeed, alas... there were many other troubles along the way...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
此路径曲折迷离，诚然如此，然更大的麻烦，却在于那异想体的怯懦……！竟每逢机会便仓皇遁逃！
 The paths are winding and confounding indeed, yet an even greater trouble is the Abnormality's cowardice...! To flit away like that at every opportunity!
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
唔～这片战场确实挺复杂的，不过也没那么大吧？以异想体的体型来说，它能去的地方本来就没几个……
 Hmm~ The arena was pretty complicated, yes, but it wasn't all that expansive, right? Considering the size of the Abnormality, there are only so many places it could go...
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<不，其实挺大的……算了。我们再试一次吧。>
 <No, it was pretty expansive... Ah, well. Let's try this again.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
呸……竟败于这般躲在阴影中偷袭之辈，实乃懦夫行径……
 Fie... To be defeated by such craven foes who attack from the cover of shadows...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<被家具伏击了啊……>
 <Ambushed by furnishings, huh...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我们得小心，别引来太多抽屉柜的注意。
 We'll have to be careful to not attract too many drawers' attention.
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
<默尔索，你得在自己和那件家具都处在光线下的时候，才能跟它交谈。>
 <Meursault, you have to talk to the furnishings while you and the furnishing are both in the light.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
明白了，经理。
 Yes, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
他似乎陷入了沉思。我出声叫他，却没有得到回应。
 He seems to be absorbed in deep thought. I call out to him, but fail to get a response.

【黑派工匠珍藏 —— 一款密不透气、连香气都逃不出去的黑派收藏系列 —— 目前接受预订】
 [Le Noir Artisan Collection - An airtight noir collection that does permit even fragrance to escape - Currently taking reservations]

【红派箱包匠人系列 —— 专为准备走秀的人打造的皮革行李箱系列。 —— 已售罄／无补货计划】
 [Le Rouge Malletier's Collection - Leather trunk collection for those preparing for the runway. - Out of stock / no plans for restocking]

玻璃展示柜的一角碎了。有人从那里伸手进去，顺走了一件展示中的手袋。
 One corner of the glass display is broken. Someone reached in through there and swiped one of the handbags on display.

泛红的血肉块，与苍白的脂肪层，混入灰白色的浆状物中，被涂抹在墙壁上。
 Reddish chunks of flesh and pale, white layer of fat incorporated into ash-gray mixture plastered into the walls.

与一位已被融入墙壁的黑派，四目相对。
 Met the eye of one of the Noirs who have been incorporated into the wall.

就在他正要开口说些什么的时候……
 Just as they were about to say something...

……那浆状物滴落下来，覆盖住了他的脸，将他掩埋。
 ... the mixture dripped over their face, burying them.

泛红的血肉块，与苍白的脂肪层，混入灰白色的浆状物中，被涂抹在墙壁上。
 Reddish chunks of flesh and pale, white layer of fat incorporated into ash-gray mixture plastered into the walls.

正忙着把一层层肉片，尽可能地擀薄。
 Busy at work trying to make the layers of meat as thin as possible.

你要我等到什么时候？别再磨磨蹭蹭了，赶紧把它们给我拿来！
 How long do you expect me to wait? Quit lollygagging and bring them to me, now!
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
还没开张呢。别催了，等着吧。
 Not open yet. Quit rushing me and wait.
texts.speaker:
黑派手袋馆设计师
 Le Noir Handbags Hall Designer

texts.text:
在墙上的浆状物滑落、掩埋住那张脸之前，瞥见了一抹转瞬即逝的微笑。
 Saw the briefest glimpse of a smile before the wall mixture slid down and buried the face behind it.

几个看起来像是手袋的东西，屏息静默地伫立着，一动不动。
 Handbag... -looking things are sitting still in silent, bated breath.

嗯哼，嗯哼。瞧瞧我，多么厚实、多么结实。
 Mmhm, mmhm. Look at me, so dense and sturdy.
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
我的身价，只会一直涨下去。
 My price won't ever stop going up.
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
介意一下好吗？把目光移开，不然你会用视线把我磨损掉的。
 Do you mind? Look away, or you'll wear me away with your gaze.
texts.speaker:
设计师的杰作
 The Designer's Chef D'oeuvre

texts.text:
一盆看起来相当健康的植物。有几片叶子已经被摘掉了。
 A rather healthy-looking pot of plant. Some of its leaves has been plucked out.

一张黑色沙发。
 A black sofa.

各式各样的家具，从我们四周吱嘎作响地活了过来……开始朝我们的方向悄悄爬近。
 Furnishings of all kinds creak to life from all around us... and begin to creep in our direction.

这是个滑梯。好玩的部分到底是往下滑呢……还是滑完之后再爬上去？
 It's a slide. Is the fun part going down... or climbing back up after?
